blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A vision-language model may take left-right direction from the orientation of image content within patches, its vision transformer's (ViT) position code, or token positions and order in its language model (LLM). Ablations show the ViT code is necessary; we test sufficiency by mirroring only a position code. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B, mirroring ViT width positions reproduces the flipped-image answer on 84.3-93.2% of CV-Bench left-right questions (Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 87.5%, partly a left fallback). With two options, this also counts disruption; a half-grid shift flips most answers too. With the ViT code intact, LLM-side id and token-order mirrors change few left-right answers in all three series (a weak id test in Qwen2.5-VL). In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the effect sits in the global-attention ViT blocks, mostly the last. On What'sUp, flipping content and token order, not the position code, keeps more on/under than left-right answers at the flipped-image answer. Post hoc analyses qualify these results. On CV-Bench items with located objects, random permutations flip 18.9-31.0 points more answers when reversing the objects' order than when keeping it. On What'sUp, in Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL, the share of the left-right changes made by random permutations that land on the mirror relation is mostly below chance. Counted as returns to the original answer, the What'sUp contrast of support with left-right relations is clear only in InternVL3-2B. Most remaining errors give the same relation whichever object is asked about, suggesting that repair may target relation binding, object localization or use of the reference object.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型可以从图象内容在补丁内的方向,其视觉变形器(ViT)位置代码,或其语言模型(LLM)中的符号位置和顺序中取出左向右方向. 缩写显示ViT代码是必要的;我们只通过镜像一个位置代码来测试是否足够. 在Quen2.5-VL-7B,Quen3-VL-4B和InternVL3-2B中,反射出VIT宽度位置复制了84.3-93.2%CV-Bench左后方问题上被翻转的图像答案(Quen2.5-VL-3B:87.5%,部分为左后倒). 有了两个选项,这也算作中断;半网格的转动也会翻转大多数答案. 由于ViT代码完好无损,LLM-side id和sord-order-servers镜像在所有三个系列中都改变很少左-右答案(Quen2.5-VL中一个弱的id测试). 在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,效果坐落在全局关注的Vit块中,多为后一. 在"What's Up"上,翻转内容和令牌顺序,而不是位置代码,在被翻转的图像解答时,比起左向右的答案,保持了更多的上下. 事后分析对这些结果作了限定。 在带有定位对象的 CV- Bench 项上,随机相接翻转18.9-31.0 倒转对象顺序时比保持对象顺序时多分. 在"What's Up"上,在Quen2.5-VL和Quen3-VL中,由随机地穿行而来,在镜像关系上登陆的左-右修改比例大多低于概率. 被算作回原答案,支持与左-右关系的What's Up对比只在InternVL3-2B中清晰可见. 大多数剩余的错误都给出了与所询问对象相同的关系,表明修补可以瞄准关联绑定,对象定位或使用参考对象.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Asked whether a cup is to the left of a plate, a vision-language model (VLM) has to turn the layout of an image into a word. Current VLMs often get such questions wrong [ 1 , 2 ] , their answers about up and down can follow priors more than the image [ 3 ] , and near–far answers can follow statistical shortcuts such as height in the image [ 4 ] . Diagnosing and repairing these failures requires knowing where the directional information that the model uses comes from. A VLM offers three routes: the content of the image patches, the position code that the vision transformer (ViT) attaches to each patch, and the position ids and order of the visual tokens in the language model (LLM).
blocks.zh: 被问到杯子是否位于盘子的左边,视觉语言模型(VLM)必须把图像的布局转换为单词. 当前的VLM经常会错误地得到这样的问题[1,2],他们关于上下行的答案可以比图像[3]更跟随前行,而相近-远行的答案可以跟随统计快捷键,比如图像中的高度[4]. 诊断和修复这些故障需要知道模型使用的方向信息来自何处. 一个VLM提供了三种路线:图像补丁的内容,视觉变压器(ViT)给每个补丁所附加的位置代码,以及语言模型(LLM)中视觉符号的位置ID和顺序.

blocks.en: Prior work shows that the ViT position code is necessary for spatial answers, or correlated with them. Ablating or shuffling position encodings shows that spatial understanding relies more on the vision encoder’s position encoding than on the LLM’s [ 5 ] , and the horizontal component of ViT attention is associated with left–right judgments [ 6 ] . Patching visual-token content or activations from a counterfactual or mirrored image flips left–right answers by editing what the tokens contain [ 7 , 8 ] . None of these studies compares the answer after an edit of the position code alone, item by item, with the answer to a real flip ( Section 2 ). In LLaVA-1.5, shuffling the visual tokens barely changes CV-Bench accuracy but sharply lowers it on a synthetic benchmark without semantic shortcuts [ 9 ] , so the LLM can depend on token positions. That it reads left and right from its own position ids or from the token order, which such shuffles do not separate, has not been ruled out with structured edits. A real image flip cannot settle this, because it changes all three routes at once.
blocks.zh: 先前的研究表明,ViT位置代码对于空间答案是必要的,或者与之相关. 分解或分解位置编码显示,空间理解更多地依赖于视觉编码器的位置编码,而不是LLM的[5],而ViT关注的横向部分与左-右判断[6]相关. 从反事实或镜像中补入可视化键内容或激活图像翻转出左-右的答案,通过编辑符号包含的内容 [7, 8]. 这些研究都没有将仅编辑位置代码后的答案,逐项比较,将答案比作真实翻转(第2节. 在LLaVA-1.5中,打乱可视符号几乎不会改变CV-Bench的精度,但会急剧地降低在合成基准上,没有语义快捷[9],因此LLM可以依赖符号位置. 它从自己的位置 ID 或符号顺序中读出左右, 而这种洗牌不分开, 并不排除结构化编辑。 一个真实的图像翻转不能解决这一点,因为它会同时改变所有三个路线.

blocks.en: We answer the question with position-only counterfactuals. Leaving every pixel unchanged, we mirror the position information along one axis, in the ViT or in the LLM, and compare the answer with the one the model gives for the flipped image ( Figure 1 ). If mirroring only the ViT width positions makes the model answer as if the image were flipped, the ViT position code is sufficient to change the answer. With four options (What’sUp), the share of changes that go to the mirror relation, rather than to an off-axis option, shows that the change goes to the opposite side; a half-grid shift of the code reaches a similar share. We treat sufficiency as a graded quantity: the share of questions on which the edit alone reproduces the answer to the real flip. With two options this share also contains changes that any disturbance of the code would cause, so we compare the mirror with non-mirror permutations of the same code. Part of the outcome can be expected from the architecture. Apart from its position code, a ViT processes each patch in nearly the same way wherever the patch lies, so mirroring the width positions comes close to moving every patch to its mirrored cell without flipping its content. Only the patch content, the window partition and the merge order stay unmirrored, and a content-only control tests the first. That the edit changes left–right answers is thus expected; only the intervention shows how much of the answer changes with the code. The design tests the LLM-side ids and the token order separately and applies to rotary and learned absolute position embeddings.
blocks.zh: 我们用只针对立场的反事实来回答这个问题。 将每个像素保持不变,我们沿着一轴、VIT或LLM镜像位置信息,并将答案与模型为被翻转的图像给出的答案进行比较(图1)。 如果只镜像ViT宽度位置使得模型答案如同图像被翻转一样,ViT位置代码就足以改变答案. 有了四个选项(What's Up),转至镜像关系而不是离轴选项的更改份额显示,更改会转至相反的一面;代码的半网格转接会达到相类似的份额. 我们把充足性当作一个分级的数量:仅编辑就复制真实翻转的答案的问题的比例. 有了两个选项,这个共享也包含代码会引发的任何扰动的改变,所以我们比较镜像和同代码的非模拟外观. 部分成果可以预期从架构中产生. 除了其位置代码外,一个ViT处理每个补丁的方式几乎相同,无论该补丁位于何处,因此镜像宽度位置接近将每个补丁移动到被镜像的单元格而无需翻转内容. 只有补丁内容,窗口分区和合并顺序保持未忘,且仅内容控制测试第一. 因此,编辑会改变左-右的答案;只有干预显示答案中有多少会随着代码而改变。 设计分别测试了LLM-side ids和符号顺序,并适用于旋转和所学的绝对位置嵌入.

blocks.en: Our headline results use one model from each of the three series, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B. Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B form the core models of the main runs, and InternVL3-8B serves as a scale check. The left–right permutation controls were run on the three headline models and on Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Two of the results below could not be read off the architecture: the dominance of the last ViT block and a contrast between on / under and left–right answers under a content-only flip. Our contributions are: 1. A training-free probe of the position code of VLMs (‘probe’ here means this intervention, not a probing classifier). Its position-only counterfactuals mirror or reorder positions per axis, in the ViT or on the LLM side, with pixels fixed and a real flip as reference ( Section 3 ). With it, mirroring only the ViT width positions reproduces the answer to a real horizontal flip on most CV-Bench left–right questions of Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B (93.2% in Qwen2.5-VL-7B). In Qwen2.5-VL-3B part of this rate is a fallback to its left prior. Non-mirror permutations also flip many answers, a half-grid shift most of them. Post hoc, we located the two objects in 57–63% of the geometry-consistent CV-Bench items. On these items, random permutations flip more answers when they reverse the order of the objects than when they keep it, but order-preserving ones still flip many. On CV-Bench the answer thus tends to follow the objects’ order in the ViT code and is also disturbed by the permutation itself ( Section 4.1 ). 2. A decomposition of the LLM side. With the ViT position code intact, the LLM-side ids and token order add no detectable effect on the left–right direction in the three model series, as a serial architecture makes plausible. Mirroring the LLM-side width ids changes at most 2.8% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers (correct on both the original and the flipped image) in every model, option order and tiling we tested, including InternVL3 under its default dynamic tiling. Reordering the visual tokens changes them no more than an off-axis control does. The id test is weak by construction in Qwen2.5-VL; the token order was tested in all three series. With the ViT width code removed, left–right accuracy falls to near chance, and a weak LLM-side contribution is not excluded. In one public fine-tuned model, SpatialLadder, a component swap attributes the accuracy gain to the LLM ( Sections 4.2 and 4.7 ). 3. A localization of the effect in Qwen2.5-VL-7B to the four global-attention ViT blocks, chiefly the last. The small share of the windowed blocks, which see positions only within their windows, is expected, but the dominance of the last block is not ( Section 4.4 ). 4. Up–down, support and depth answers. Up–down answers change under the ViT height mirror to a degree that varies with benchmark and model. On What’sUp, flipping the content and the token rows vertically, with the position code unchanged, leaves more on and under answers at the flipped-image answer than the horizontal version leaves left–right answers. This contrasts support with projective relations, and it counts changes to off-axis options; counted only as returns to the original answer (post hoc), it is clear only in InternVL3-2B. On CV-Bench 3D, the use by Qwen2.5-VL-7B of the cue that higher in the image means farther depends on the intact height code. Random row permutations of that code also push answers away from the cue, however, so the direction of the change is not specific to the mirror. In the 3B model the effect is weaker, and on EmbSpatial the dependence does not replicate ( Sections 4.5 and 4.6 ).

blocks.en: 2 Related work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Benchmarks such as VSR [ 10 ] , What’sUp [ 1 ] , CV-Bench [ 2 ] and EmbSpatial-Bench [ 11 ] document that VLMs often fail at basic spatial relations. With a blank-image control, horizontal relations were found to be grounded in the image in every capable model among 14 VLMs, whereas vertical relations relied largely on priors; the depth axis, though decodable, was deployed with the wrong sign [ 3 ] . Many spatial questions can be answered without the image at all [ 12 ] . Depth judgments follow pictorial cues such as ‘higher in the image means farther’ [ 4 ] , and controlling these cues in the stimulus shows which one is used [ 13 ] . Depth order can even remain linearly decodable from the queried objects’ visual tokens in the LLM when the answer follows a misleading cue, and writing the decoded direction back into these tokens shifts the answers [ 14 ] . Such cues are often valid, and following them becomes a shortcut [ 15 ] only where the image contradicts them. VLMs also default to the camera’s viewpoint when the reference frame is ambiguous [ 16 , 17 ] .
blocks.zh: VSR [10],What's Up [1],CV-Bench [2]和EmbSpatial-Bench [11]等基准文件证明,VLMs在基本空间关系上经常会失败. 通过空白图像控制,发现横向关系基于14个VLM中每个能建模的图像,而纵向关系主要依赖于前作;深度轴虽然可以解码,但部署的标志错误[3]. 许多空间问题可以在完全没有图像的情况下回答[12]. 深度判断遵循了图片提示,如"图像更高意味着更远"[4],在刺激中控制这些提示显示使用哪个 [13] 。 深度命令甚至可以在LLM中从被询问对象的视觉符号中保持线性可解码,当答案遵循了误导提示时,将被解码的方向回写到这些符号中会让答案 [14] 。 这样的提示常常是有效的,并且只有在图像与它们相矛盾时,才会跟着它们成为捷径[15]. VLMs在参考框架模糊时也默认了相机的观点[16,17].

blocks.en: Vision encoders mark patch positions with learned absolute embeddings [ 18 ] or with two-dimensional RoPE [ 19 , 20 ] . In ViT classifiers, per-axis interventions show that RoPE and absolute embeddings store position differently [ 21 ] . Positional embeddings can also help or hurt spatial reasoning [ 22 ] . On the LLM side, multimodal RoPE assigns separate position components to time, height and width [ 23 ] , and its design has been compared systematically [ 24 ] . The closest work masks, shuffles or fixes these encodings per axis, in the ViT and on the LLM side of Qwen2.5-VL-7B and two other VLMs. It finds that spatial understanding relies more on the vision encoder’s encodings than on the LLM’s [ 5 ] . Its ablations of the LLM-side x x ids also change some left answers, but an ablation is not a mirror ( Section 4.2 ). On What’sUp, ablating the ViT width encoding of Qwen2.5-VL-7B collapses its left and right answers, so the ViT’s position encoding is necessary for them; one of these ablations is a random permutation of the ViT width ids. The changed answers are not compared item by item with a real image transform, and where they go is not reported. In our post hoc split on CV-Bench, such random permutations flip more answers when they reverse the order of the two objects than when they keep it ( B ). On procedurally generated scenes, Liu and Chen [ 25 ] find a double dissociation of the two axes when they ablate the encoder’s width or height positional channel. They also trace the answer through image-token states at an early decoder stage. On What’sUp and ARO they extend this mediation with mirror-flip counterfactuals. We mirror the position code instead of ablating it, keep the pixels fixed, and compare the answer item by item with a real flip. When high-resolution inputs degrade the visual position encodings, shuffling them shifts coordinate predictions consistently toward the model’s spatial priors [ 26 ] . Another study [ 6 ] decomposes ViT attention under 2D-RoPE into horizontal and vertical components and associates the horizontal one with left–right judgments. Its embedding-level interventions replace one object’s embedding with another’s or mix direction vectors in the image embeddings after the modality connector, and measure the probability of the correct answer or the drop in performance. Removing 2D-RoPE serves only to show that the direction vectors lose their geometry, and rescaling the rotary frequencies of the vision encoder mostly raises benchmark accuracy. None of these interventions mirrors one axis of the position code or compares the answer item by item with a real flip. In CLIP-style encoders trained on synthetic one-dimensional scenes, the interaction of position and token embeddings creates a horizontal attention gradient that breaks left–right symmetry, and ablating it weakens left–right discrimination [ 27 ] . In LLaVA-1.5, randomly permuting the visual tokens barely changes CV-Bench accuracy but lowers accuracy on a synthetic benchmark without semantic shortcuts, so standard benchmarks can mask such position sensitivity [ 9 ] . Removing visual tokens whose RoPE positions act as implicit coordinates, or merging tokens and re-assigning their position ids, lowers visual-grounding accuracy [ 28 ] . We test left and right with structured mirrors in pretrained VLMs of three series and separate the LLM-side ids from the token order (token shuffling versus mirrors: Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 视野编码器标记补丁位置,并有已学习到的绝对嵌入[18]或有二维RoPE[19,20]. 在ViT分级器中,每轴干预显示ROPE和绝对嵌入存储位置不同[21]. 位置嵌入也可以帮助或伤害空间推理 [22]. 在LLM方面,多式ROPE为时间,高度和宽度分配了单独的位置组件 [23],其设计被系统比较 [24]. 在ViT和LLM侧的Quen2.5-VL-7B和另外两个VLM中,每轴最接近的工作口罩,洗涤或修复这些编码. 与LLM的[5]相比, 它的LLM- side x x ids的活化也改变了一些左向的答案,但活化不是镜子(第4.2节. 在What's Up上,将Quen2.5-VL-7B的ViT宽编码崩溃了它的左右答案,所以ViT的位置编码对他们来说是必要的;其中之一的活化是ViT宽码的随机通缩. 所改变的答案不是按项目与真实的图像转换进行比较,它们去的地方也不报告. 在我们的CV-Bench上的后临时分出中,这种随机的通量在两个对象的顺序倒转时会比保留时(B.)翻出更多的答案. 在程序生成的场景上,刘和陈[25]在将编码器的宽度或高位通道降低时,发现两轴的双相分离. 他们还在早期解码阶段通过图像键状态来追踪答案. 在What's Up和ARO上, 我们镜像位置代码,而不是打磨它,保持像素的固定,并且逐项比较答案项目与真正的翻转. 当高分辨输入会降低视觉位置编码时, 另一项研究[6]将2D-ROPE下的ViT关注分解为横向和纵向组件,并将横向一与左-右判断联系起来. 它的嵌入级干预取代了在模式连接器后嵌入到图像中以另一个对象的嵌入方向向量或混合方向向量,并测量正确答案或性能下降的概率. 删除2D-ROPE只能显示方向向量会失去几何特征,而调整视线编码器的回旋频率大多提高基准精确度. 这些发言都没有反映位置代码的一个轴线,也没有将答题逐项地比作真实的翻转. 在经过合成一维场景培训的CLIP风格编码器中,位置和符号嵌入的相互作用创造了一个横向的注意梯度,打破了左-右对称,并点燃它会削弱左-右歧视[27]. 在LLaVA-1.5中,随机穿透可视符号几乎不会改变CV-Bench的精度,但会降低合成基准上的精度,没有语义快捷键,所以标准基准可以掩盖这种位置灵敏度[9]. 移除其RoPE位置作为隐含坐标的可视化标志,或合并可视化标志并重新分配其位置标识,降低可视化定位精度[28]. 我们用结构化的镜像在三个系列的预受训练的VLM中进行左右测试,并将LLM-侧的ID从符号顺序中分离出(token shuffling versions: 第5.3节).

blocks.en: Our counterfactuals follow the logic of activation patching and interchange interventions [ 29 ] . Patching a value from a corrupted run into the clean run (noising) tests whether the variable is necessary, whereas patching the clean value into the corrupted run (denoising) tests whether it is sufficient [ 30 ] . A position-only mirror gives each patch the position id it has in the flipped image. With the flipped-image run as the clean run, it is a denoising patch of the assignment of positions to content; because the variable is an input-side id, its counterfactual value is known exactly and needs no second forward pass. Three analyses that intervene on content or activations also use a flipped or swapped image as the counterfactual. Patching content embeddings locates spatial information mainly in the vision encoder, spread over all visual tokens, and swapping the left and right regions of the visual-token embeddings with those of a counterfactual image flips predictions [ 7 ] . In the same work, a secondary, language-side ordering representation can partly act as a backup when the vision-derived ordering is removed. Inside the LLM, linear spatial identifiers in object-word activations can be edited to flip left–right answers, and activations from the run on a mirrored image, patched into the original run, also flip them [ 8 ] . Patching image, query-text or final-token states between an image and its horizontal flip, on items answered correctly in both, shows in Qwen3-VL-4B that spatial relations are read from the query text tokens [ 31 ] . The first two link these signals to position encoding. The first traces band-like patterns in the visual embeddings to the encoder’s positional encoding; in the second, a low-rank linear map from positional encodings explains most of the variance of the spatial identifiers. We add a causal test of this link. In the LLM, activation patching traces how objects are bound to their roles [ 32 ] , and direction patching places the causal effect of spatial directions in middle and deep layers [ 33 ] . Spatial judgments have also been described as coarse object grounding followed by reasoning [ 34 ] . For contrastive encoders, a symmetric readout cancels direction that the frozen encoder still contains [ 35 ] . Methods that improve spatial answers, finally, use flips and subject–object swaps as training-free consistency signals [ 36 , 37 ] , re-weight attention at inference [ 38 ] or scale attention heads [ 39 ] . Unlike these methods and the sufficiency-type interventions above, ours acts on the input-side position code with the content fixed. In video LLMs, reversing the frame order lowers temporal understanding far more than editing the position encodings [ 40 ] , a precedent for separating position ids from token order. Table 1 summarizes the closest works.
blocks.zh: 我们的反事实遵循了激活补丁和交换干预的逻辑[29]. 从被损坏的运行中补入一个值, 以测试该变量是否必要, 而将清洁值补入被损坏的运行( 排除) 测试其是否足够 [30] 。 仅一个位置的镜像会给每个补丁它在被翻转的图像中的位置ID. 以被翻转的图像运行为"干净运行",是将位置分配到内容的去名补丁;由于变量是输入-侧式的ID,其反事实值是完全已知的,无需再过一秒. 干预内容或活化的三种分析也使用被翻转或相换的图像作为反事实. 补丁内容嵌入主要定位于视觉编码器中的空间信息,分布于所有可视符号上,并用反事实图像翻转预测来交换可视嵌入物的左右区域. [7]. 在同一作中,在取出视觉命令时,副语言方排序表示可以部分发挥备份的作用. 在LLM内部,对象-字活化中的线性空间识别符可以被编辑为向左-向右倒转答案,从运行到被镜像上的活化,被补入原始运行,也可以被翻转 [8]. 在图像和其水平翻转之间补丁图像,查询-文本或最终键态,在两个中正确回答的项目上,在Qune3-VL-4B中显示空间关系从查询文本符读取 [31]. 前两个将这些信号链接到位置编码上. 在视觉嵌入到编码器位置编码中的第一个跟踪带状图案;在第二个中,从位置编码中得出的低等线性图能解释空间标识符的大部分差异. 我们添加了对这一联系的因果关系检验。 在LLM中,活化补丁跟踪物体如何被束缚在角色上[32],而方向补丁将空间方向的因果关系放入中深地层[33]. 空间判断也被描述为粗糙物体搁浅,然后是推理 [34]. 对于对比编码器,一个对称读出会取消被冻结的编码器仍然包含[35]的方向. 改进空间答案的方法,最后是使用翻转和主题-对象交换作为无训练一致性信号[36,37],再加权注意在推论[38]或比例注意头[39]. 与以上这些方法及"充足"类型的干预不同,我们的操作是输入-侧位置代码,内容被固定. 在Video LLMs中,倒置帧令会比编辑位置编码[40]更会降低时间理解,这是将位置ids与令牌顺序分开的先例. 表1总结了最近的作品。

blocks.en: 3 Position-only counterfactuals
blocks.zh: 3 仅位置反事实

blocks.en: 3.1 Where position enters a VLM
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 位置输入 VLM

blocks.en: A vision-language model (VLM) receives spatial position at two places. Inside the vision encoder, every patch token carries a position code. Qwen2.5-VL [ 20 ] applies a two-dimensional rotary position embedding (2D-RoPE [ 19 , 41 ] ) in every block of its vision transformer (ViT [ 18 ] ). The rotation angle depends on the patch row h h and column w w . InternVL3 [ 42 ] instead adds a learned absolute position embedding once, before the first block. After the encoder, the visual tokens are serialized into the language model (LLM), where they receive LLM-side position ids. Qwen2.5-VL uses multimodal RoPE (M-RoPE [ 23 ] ) with separate temporal, height and width components. InternVL3 uses one-dimensional RoPE over the token sequence, trained with variable position increments for visual tokens [ 43 ] . At inference the released implementation assigns consecutive ids (increment 1) to all tokens, and we edit these ids ( A ). A third route is the patch content itself, which can carry orientation cues independently of any position code.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLM)在两地得到空间位置. 在视觉编码器内部,每个补丁符号都带有位置代码. Quen2.5-VL [20] 在其视变器的每个区块(ViT [18])上都应用了二维回转位置嵌入(2D-ROPE [19,41]). 旋转角度取决于补丁行h和列w. InternVL3 [42] 取而代之的是,在第1个块之前,添加了一次已学会的绝对位置嵌入. 编码后,可视符号被序列化为语言模型(LLM),在那里它们接收了LLM-side位置的ID. Quen2.5-VL使用多式RoPE(M-ROPE [23]),分时间,高度和宽度等组件. InternVL3使用一维ROPE凌驾于符号序列之上,经过可变位置增量的训练,用于视觉符号 [43]. 推论发布执行会为所有符号分配相接的ID(递增 1),我们编辑这些ID(A. 第三种途径是补丁内容本身,它可以独立于任何位置代码携带方向提示.

blocks.en: A rotary embedding rotates the query and key vectors of each patch by angles proportional to its row h h and column w w , so that the attention between two patches depends on their offset. Replacing w w by W − 1 − w W-1-w therefore makes every patch behave as if it sat in the mirrored column, while its pixels stay where they are; for a learned absolute embedding the same edit re-indexes the table of position vectors. If the model then answers as it does for the flipped image, the column index alone is enough to produce the flipped-image answer, which is a test of sufficiency.
blocks.zh: 旋转嵌入会将每个补丁的查询和密钥向量以与其行hh和列ww相正比的角度来旋转,这样两个补丁之间的注意力就取决于它们的相抵. 因此,用 W − 1 − w − w − w 代替 w 使得每一个补丁都表现得像它坐在被镜像的列上一样,而它的像素则停留在原地;对于一个已学会的绝对嵌入相同的编辑重新索引位置向量表. 如果模型再像对被翻转的图像那样回答,单列索引就足以产生被翻转的图像答案,这是对是否足够的测试.

blocks.en: A real flip changes all three routes at once; our counterfactuals change one route at a time while leaving every pixel unchanged ( Figure 1 ; rates on the geometry-consistent items in Figure 2 ). For a position route, the edited variable is the assignment of positions to content: each patch receives the position id that it has in the flipped image, while its pixels stay in place. We call a route sufficient for the forced-choice answer to the degree that this replacement, with all other routes at their original values, reproduces the answer given for the flipped image. Sufficiency is thus a graded quantity, measured as agreement with the real transform or as a flip rate ( Section 3.4 ). If the answer stays unchanged, we detect no use of that route for the direction while the other routes are intact; this does not show that the route could not carry direction on its own.
blocks.zh: 真正的翻转会同时改变所有三条路线;我们的反事实会一次改变一条路线,同时使每个像素不变(图1;图2中几何相容项目的速率). 对于一个位置路由,被编辑的变量是给内容分配位置:每个补丁都收到它在被翻转的图像中的位置ID,而其像素则保持原位. 我们称一条路线足以满足强制选择的答案,以至于这个替换方式,加上所有其他路线的原值,复制了为被翻转的图像给出的答案. 因此,充分性是一个分级数量,以与实际变换一致或以翻转率衡量(第3.4节)。 如果答案保持不变,我们检测到该路线没有用于该方向,而其他路线完好无损;这并不能表明该路线无法自行携带方向.

blocks.zh: 3.2 反事实行动

blocks.en: For Qwen2.5-VL we replace the ViT’s rotary position ids by their mirror image along one axis, w ′ = W − 1 − w w^{\prime}=W-1-w (or h ′ = H − 1 − h h^{\prime}=H-1-h ) on the W × H W\times H patch grid of the image. The rotary embedding is then recomputed from these ids. The mirrored ids are generated before the encoder’s 2 × 2 2{\times}2 spatial-merge reordering, so the reordering of tokens and the mirroring of id values do not interact. With no mirroring, our re-implementation reproduces the original rotary embedding element-wise; this is checked before every run. For InternVL3 we mirror the learned absolute position embedding on its 32 × 32 32\times 32 patch grid and leave the class token unchanged. To keep this a clean permutation, InternVL3 is run with a single 448 × 448 448\times 448 tile (256 visual tokens) instead of dynamic tiling; a check under the default tiling mirrors the embedding within each tile ( Section 4.2 ). A pixel flip and a mirror of the patch grid then act on the same grid of patches. The image is resized to the tile without preserving its aspect ratio. Qwen2.5-VL keeps the aspect ratio and is limited to 1280 ⋅ 28 ⋅ 28 1280\cdot 28\cdot 28 pixels. The ViT of Qwen3-VL has both a learned absolute embedding and 2D-RoPE, and we mirror both with the same permutation; it keeps the aspect ratio and is limited to 1280 ⋅ 32 ⋅ 32 1280\cdot 32\cdot 32 pixels.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen2.5-VL,我们用一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一轴一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等一等 然后从这些标识中重新计算出旋转嵌入. 被镜像的ID是在编码器的2×2 2\times}2空间-相并重排之前生成的,因此重新排列符和id值的镜像没有相互作用. 在没有镜像的情况下,我们的再执行将复制原旋转嵌入元素;在每次运行前都会检查这个. 对InternVL3来说,我们反映其32×3232\times 32补丁网格上嵌入的已学到的绝对位置,并保持类符号不变. 为了保持这种平整,InternVL3运行时会使用一单448×448\times 448个平板(256个可视化符号)来代替动态平板;默认平板下的一个检查会反射出每个平板内部的嵌入(第4.2节). 一个像素翻转和一个补丁网格的镜像,然后在同一个补丁网格上作用. 图像被调整为平板,而不保留其外观比. Quen2.5-VL保持了外观比并被限制在1280 → 28 → 28 1280\cdot 28\cdot 28像素. Qwen3-VL的ViT既有学有学有学有学有学的绝对嵌入和2D-ROPE,我们两个都以相同的通相镜相映射;它保持了外观比并被限制在1280~32~32~1280\cdot 32\cdot 32像素.

blocks.en: For Qwen2.5-VL we mirror the width (or height) component of the M-RoPE ids of the visual tokens within the span of each image, w ′ = w min + w max − w w^{\prime}=w_{\min}+w_{\max}-w . This is a permutation of ids within the image span, so the largest position id and the offsets of the following text tokens are unchanged. M-RoPE allocates its width component to the lowest-frequency channels, so this edit changes rotation angles only slightly ( Section 4.2 ). For InternVL3, whose LLM has only one-dimensional positions, we apply the corresponding permutation to the position ids of the visual tokens (within each row for the width axis, across rows for the height axis). For Qwen3-VL we mirror the width component of its LLM-side ids as in Qwen2.5-VL.
blocks.zh: 对于Quen2.5-VL,我们反射每个图像间距内视觉符号的M-ROPE IDs的宽度(或高度)部分,w = w min + w 最大- w = w prime }=w _{\- min}+w_{\- max}-w. 这是在图像跨度内对ids的通缩,所以以下文字符号的最大位置id和相抵不变. M-ROPE将其宽度组件分配到最低频通道,因此这个编辑只略微地改变旋转角度(第4.2节. 对于LLM只有一维位置的InternVL3,我们对视觉符号的位置ID(每行内为宽轴,跨行为高轴)应用相应的通相. 对于Quen3-VL,我们反射其LLM-侧式ID的宽度组件,如Quen2.5-VL.

blocks.en: A causal LLM could also read direction from the serialization order of the visual tokens rather than from their ids, and we separate the two in Qwen2.5-VL, InternVL3-2B and Qwen3-VL. In order-only conditions each visual token keeps its own position id but moves to a new seat in the sequence: the order is mirrored along the width or the height axis, or row-major order is replaced by column-major. Relative rotary positions are unchanged and only the causal order changes. In id-only conditions the tokens stay in place and their ids are mirrored (this equals LLM-W or LLM-H ); order-and-id conditions apply both. As controls for the height axis we add two row permutations of the same strength that do not correspond to a vertical mirror: a cyclic shift of the rows by half the height and a random row shuffle (three seeds).

blocks.en: Each position-only counterfactual is compared with the matching real image transform: ViT-W and LLM-W with a real horizontal flip ( H-flip ), and ViT-H and LLM-H with a real vertical flip ( V-flip ). A position-only 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotation, which mirrors both axes of the ViT position code and of the LLM-side position ids while leaving the token order unchanged, is compared with a real 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotation. The off-axis counterfactual, for example ViT-W on up–down questions, is a control: a directional effect should flip the answers of the matching axis and leave the other axis largely intact. A position-only mirror does not reproduce a real flip in every respect. The pixels inside each patch keep their orientation, and the order in which the encoder merges neighboring patches is unchanged. So is the seat of each visual token in the LLM sequence. ‘Sufficient’ therefore means that, among the differences between an image and its mirror image, the mirrored position code alone is enough to produce the flipped answer. The remaining differences are the competing explanations: the orientation of the pixels within each patch, the window partition of the encoder (which patches attend to each other in windowed blocks) and the order of the 2 × 2 2{\times}2 merger. As a complementary content-only control, we flip the pixels and flip the ViT and LLM width ids back without reordering the tokens, so that the content, including the within-patch orientation, is mirrored together with the order in which the visual tokens enter the LLM; window partition and merge order are not tested separately.
blocks.zh: 每个仅位置反事实都与匹配的真实图像变换相比较:VIT-W和LLM-W具有真实水平翻转(H-flip ),而VIT-H和LLM-H具有真实垂直翻转(V-flip ). 仅以180 QQ 180 Circ}旋转,既能反射出ViT位置代码的轴,又能反射出LLM-侧位置ID的轴而使符号顺序不变,与实际180 QQ 180 Circ}旋转作比较. 离轴反事实,例如上下问题上的ViT-W,是一个控制:方向效应应该翻转匹配轴的答案,并让其他轴基本完整. 只有位置的镜像不会在各个方面复制出真正的翻转. 每个补丁内的像素保持取向,编码器合并相邻补丁的顺序不变. LLM序列中每个视觉符号的座位也是这样. 因此,“足够”意味着,在图像与其镜像的区别中,仅用镜像位置代码就足以产生被翻转的答案。 所剩差异有相竞解释:每个补丁内像素的取向,编码器的窗口分区(它以被窗口的块相接相接相接)和2×2 2\times}2合并的顺序. 作为一种互补的唯内容控件,我们将像素翻回并翻回了ViT和LLM宽度ID,而无需重排符号,这样内容,包括patch取向,就与可视符入LLM的顺序相映射;窗口分区和合并顺序不单独测试.

blocks.en: The ViT of Qwen2.5-VL has 32 blocks; four of them (blocks 7, 15, 23 and 31) use global attention and the rest windowed attention. We also apply the width mirror only in selected blocks: in a single block, in the four global-attention blocks, in all blocks except the last, or in the first or last L L blocks ( L = 0 , 4 , … , 32 L=0,4,\dots,32 ). Further conditions mirror the 28 windowed blocks alone and other sets of global-attention and late blocks ( Section 4.4 ). Because RoPE acts anew in every block, these conditions tell which blocks’ rotations determine the output, not where the information is first written.
blocks.zh: Quen2.5-VL的ViT有32个街区;其中4个街区(7,15,23和31个街区)使用全局关注,其余的被窗口关注. 我们还只在选定的区块中应用宽镜:在一个区块、四个全局注意区块、除最后一个区块外的所有区块,或第一个或最后一个LL区块(L=0、4、.、32L=0、4、\dots、32)。 其他条件反映了仅28个窗口区块和其他一组全球注意和后期区块(第4.4节)。 因为ROPE在每个区块中都有新的动作,这些条件说明哪个区块的旋转决定了输出,而不是信息最早写在哪里.

blocks.en: 3.3 Models and data
blocks.zh: 3.3 模型和数据

blocks.en: We study Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct (2D-RoPE in the ViT, M-RoPE in the LLM) and InternVL3-2B (learned absolute position embedding in the ViT, one-dimensional RoPE in the LLM). Each of the two common position-code designs of current open VLMs is thus represented by one vision encoder; InternVL3-2B and -8B use the same InternViT-300M encoder architecture. We call Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B, on which the main runs and all control analyses were run, the core models ; the headline results of Section 1 use Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B, one model per series. As a scale check for the cross-axis leakage of the absolute-embedding mirror, we also ran InternVL3-8B on CV-Bench and What’sUp with the same code and settings. Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct [ 44 ] , the third headline model, was run on both benchmarks with the main ViT- and LLM-side left–right conditions and the CV-Bench up–down mirrors, and, post hoc, with the same-axis permutation controls ( Tables 2 and 4 ). Model revisions are fixed and listed in A . The main benchmark is the Relation subset of CV-Bench 2D [ 2 ] : 650 questions, of which 383 ask whether one object is left or right of another and 267 ask whether it is above or below. We replicate the main findings on What’sUp [ 1 ] : Controlled Images A has 412 questions over 206 left–right and 206 up–down images, with the four options left , right , on and under ; a comparison of its two axes is thus also one of projective relations with relations of support. Depth is studied on the Depth subset of CV-Bench 3D (a validation half and a held-out test half of 314 questions).
blocks.zh: 我们研究了Quen2.5-VL-3B-指令和Quen2.5-VL-7B-指令(2D-ROPE in the Vit, M-ROPE in the LLM)和InternVL3-2B(在Vit中学习了嵌入的绝对位置,在LLM中学习了一维RoPE). 因此,当前开放的VLM的两种常见位置码设计都分别由一视觉编码器代表;InternVL3-2B和-8B使用相同的InternViT-300M编码器架构. 我们呼号为:Quen2.5-VL-3B,Quen2.5-VL-7B和InternVL3-2B,主要运行和所有控制分析都是在其中运行,核心模型;第1节的头条结果使用Quen2.5-VL-7B,Quen3-VL-4B和InternVL3-2B,每系列一个模型. 作为绝对嵌入镜像跨轴外溢的尺度检查,我们还在CV-Bench和What's Up上运行了InternVL3-8B,其代码和设置相同. Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruction [44],是第三个头条模式,在两个基准上运行,主要有ViT-和LLM-左侧-右侧条件和CV-Bench上下反光镜,以及后特设,具有同轴穿行控制(表2和表4). 模式修订是固定的,列在A. 主要基准是CV-Bench 2D [2] 的关联子集:650个问题,其中383个问题询问一个物体是左侧还是右侧,267个问题询问是上下方. 我们复制了关于What's Up [1] 的主要发现: 受控图像 A在206个左右和206个上下图像上有412个问题,其中4个选项是左、右、上和下;因此,将其两个轴线进行比较也是与支持关系之间的投影关系。 深度被研究到CV-Bench 3D的深度子集上(314个问题的验证半和被搁置测试半).

blocks.en: 3.4 Scoring and metrics
blocks.zh: 3.4 分红和计量

blocks.en: Each question is posed once per condition with the benchmark’s multiple-choice prompt (“Answer with the option’s letter from the given choices directly”), and the answer is the option whose letter receives the highest next-token logit; no text is generated. The real and position-only 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} conditions add the sentence “Answer in terms of the image exactly as it is displayed (image coordinates), not the real-world orientation of the scene.” The main CV-Bench and What’sUp runs use bf16, where two options occasionally receive exactly equal logits; ties resolve to the first option. Ties occur in 1.9% and 6.1% of the CV-Bench rows of Qwen2.5-VL-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-3B (all conditions), in 4.5% of those of InternVL3-2B and in 0.9%–1.9% of the What’sUp rows. Because the option order of CV-Bench is fixed ( left and above are always option A), C repeats the main analyses with every tied item removed. The option-order re-runs, InternVL3-8B, Qwen3-VL-4B, video input, the block, permutation, content-only, width-removal and tiling controls, and the depth validation half also use bf16 with first-option ties. The depth test half and its permutations, the fine-tuned checkpoints, EmbSpatial, the two-tile runs and the InternVL3-2B blank image score in fp32 (no ties occurred); fine-tuned accuracy and EmbSpatial combine both option orders.
blocks.zh: 每个问题都以基准的多选择提示( " 回答直接从给定选择中选择的选项字母)作为条件提出,答案是其字母收到最高级的下一个选项;没有生成文本。 真实且仅位置的180 + 180 + Circ}条件加上了一句“从图像的准确显示(图像坐标)的角度回答,而不是场景的真实世界取向。” 主要CV-Bench和What'sUp运行使用bf16,其中两个选项偶尔得到完全相等的对数;与第一个选项的联系决心. CV-Bench行的1.9%和6.1%的Qwen2.5-VL-7B和Quen2.5-VL-3B(所有条件),其中的4.5%为InternVL3-2B,其中的0.9%为What's Up行。 由于CV-Bench的选项顺序是固定的(左上方总是选项A),因此C重复了主分析,并删除了每个被绑定的项目. 选项顺序再运行,InternVL3-8B,Quen3-VL-4B,视频输入,块,通接,只内容,宽度去除和平板控制,深度验证的一半也使用有首选项链接的bf16. 深度测试半和其通路,微调的检查站,EmbSpatial,双瓦跑和InternVL3-2B空白图像分数为fp32(无关系);微调精度和EmbSpatial结合了两种选项命令.

blocks.en: For each counterfactual we report the fraction of questions on which its answer equals the answer under the matching real transform (for example ViT-W versus H-flip ). This measures whether the position edit alone reproduces the effect of the image transform, regardless of whether either answer is correct. As a baseline we report the agreement of the original answer with the transformed-image answer.
blocks.zh: 对于每个反事实,我们报告其答案等于匹配真实变换下答案的一小部分问题(例如:Vit-W对H-flip.). 此测量位置单独编辑是否复制了图像变换的效果,无论两个答案是否正确. 作为基线,我们报告原始答案与转变的图像答案一致。

blocks.en: To isolate items on which the model follows the image geometry, we restrict to questions that the model answers correctly both on the original image and under the matching real transform; we call them geometry-consistent . We adopted this subset after the main runs, as the main directional metric, so that the flip rate is not diluted by items the model gets wrong anyway. On these items we report the fraction whose answer changes under the counterfactual. For off-axis rates on CV-Bench the subset is defined by the real transform of the edited axis (for example V-flip for ViT-H on left–right items); on What’sUp it is defined by the transform of the question’s axis ( H-flip for left–right items). On What’sUp we also report the fraction that changes to the mirror relation (for example left → \to right , or on → \to under ; the correspondence is defined in the frame of the image), since a change to an off-axis option is not a directional effect; this share, too, was adopted as the main What’sUp metric after the runs.
blocks.zh: 为了隔离模型遵循图像几何学的项目,我们仅限于模型在原始图像上和相匹配的真变下正确回答的问题;我们称之为几何-相容性. 我们在主运行后采用了这个子集,作为主要的方向性衡量标准,这样,翻转率不会被模型反正会出错的项目所淡化. 在这些项目上,我们报告在反事实下其答案发生变化的分数。 对于 CV- Bench 上的离轴速率,子集由编辑轴的真实变换来定义(例如,左-右项目上的VT-H的V-flip;通过问题轴的变换来定义的What ' sUp (左-右项目中的H-flip)。 在“What's Up”上,我们还报告镜像关系变化的分数(例如左起左起右起右起右起右起;在图像框中定义了对应关系),因为对离轴选项的改变不是方向效应;这一分数也是运行后的主要“What's Up 度量。

blocks.en: Proportions are reported with 95% Wilson intervals [ 45 ] . Differences between conditions on the same items use a paired bootstrap over questions [ 46 ] with 10,000 resamples and seed 0. The public checkpoints and the component swap ( E ) and the tile-order margin ( Section 4.2 ) use 2,000 resamples. Analyses on subsets or with metrics chosen after the main runs are marked post hoc. What’sUp shows the same object pairs in several arrangements, so its questions are not independent; our intervals treat them as independent and are therefore somewhat too narrow. The two halves of CV-Bench 3D Depth are split by a hash of the item index, not by image, so they may share images. The code and the summary outputs of all analyses are released ( A ).
blocks.zh: 报告的比例为95%的Wilson间隔[45]。 相同物品上的条件差异使用一双靴子来代替问题[46],并有10 000个复标和0个种子。 公共检查站和部件互换(E)和瓦片订单差值(第4.2节)使用2 000个复标。 对子集的分析或在主运行后选择的度量衡是标记后特设的. 我们的间隔将它们视为独立的,因此过于狭窄。 CV-Bench 3D深度的两半被项目索引的散列分出,而不是由图像分出,这样它们就可以共享图像. 发布了所有分析的代码和摘要产出(A.)。

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 ViT width mirror versus a real horizontal flip
blocks.zh: 4.1 ViT 宽镜对正水平翻转

blocks.en: With every pixel unchanged and only the ViT width ids mirrored ( ViT-W ), the model gives the answer it gives for the horizontally flipped image ( H-flip ) on most CV-Bench left–right questions. ViT-W agrees with H-flip on 84.3–93.2% of them, against 8.6–46.0% for the original answers ( Table 2 ). The high baseline of Qwen2.5-VL-3B (46.0%) comes mostly from answering left on both images. The agreement holds for both position-code families, the 2D-RoPE of Qwen2.5-VL and the learned absolute embedding of InternVL3. The converse test points the same way. When the pixels are flipped and the width ids of both ViT and LLM are flipped back, the content and the order of the token columns in the LLM are mirrored; the column order alone changes few answers ( Section 4.2 ). The answer then moves away from the flipped-image answer (‘flips back’) on 84.1% of the left–right questions for Qwen2.5-VL-7B, 76.0% for InternVL3-2B and, post hoc, 91.4% for Qwen3-VL-4B, so it follows the positions rather than the mirrored content. For Qwen2.5-VL-3B the rate is 42.8%. This model often gives the same answer to an image and to its mirror image, so its flip-back rate is low by construction.
blocks.zh: 每个像素不变,只有ViT宽度的ID被反射出(ViT-W),模型给出了它给大多数CV-Bench左-右问题上水平翻转的图像(H-flip)的答案. ViT-W同意其中84.3-93.2 %的H-flip,而原始答案为8.6-46.0%(表2)。 Qwen2.5-VL-3B(46.0%)的高基线主要来自两个图像上左侧的回答. 该协议对两个位置码家族,即Quen2.5-VL的2D-ROPE和所学到的INVL3绝对嵌入. 反向测试也指向了同样的方式. 当像素被翻转,并翻回了ViT和LLM的宽度ID时,LLM中符号列的内容和顺序都会被反射出;单列顺序改变的答案很少(第4.2节). 答案从84.1%的左-右问题(Quen2.5-VL-7B),76.0%的InternVL3-2B以及91.4%的后置问题(Quen3-VL-4B)上移出倒转的图像答案( " flips back " ),因此它遵循的是位置而不是反射的内容. 对Qun2.5-VL-3B来说,这一比率为42.8%。 这个模型经常给一个图像和它的镜像提供相同的答案,因此它的倒转率通过构造是较低的.

blocks.en: The effect is directional in the sense of axis selectivity. On the geometry-consistent items of the core models, ViT-W changes 83.3–95.4% of the left–right answers but only 4.4–7.8% of the up–down answers ( Figure 2 a). With two options, part of these flips would follow from any disturbance of the width code. Post hoc, in the core models and Qwen3-VL-4B, we located the two objects in 57–63% of the geometry-consistent items. On these items, permutations that keep the column order of the two objects flip 19–50% of the answers, permutations that reverse it 60–74% and the mirror 84–96%. A half-grid shift flips 77.6–84.0% of all geometry-consistent left–right answers (protocol, including how the objects were located, in B ). Among the random permutations alone, those that reverse the order flip 18.9–31.0 points more answers than those that keep it in all four models; the mirror exceeds the larger non-mirror permutation by margins whose intervals include zero in Qwen2.5-VL-3B and InternVL3-2B ( B ). On CV-Bench, the answers thus tend to follow the objects’ order in the code, which we did not separate from the half of the image in which the subject lands, but the flip rate alone does not measure the direction. Because a change under ViT-W is necessarily a flip, we also checked whether the flips could reflect a fallback to a left prior, which would flip only original right answers. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B the flip rates are similar for original left and right answers ( Table C.2 ), and post hoc in Qwen3-VL-4B as well (95.7% of 163 original left and 92.3% of 181 right answers flip). Flips from left to right , which a fallback to the left prior cannot produce, occur on 92.8% and 85.5% of the original left answers in these two models (62.2% in Qwen2.5-VL-3B). With swapped options the gap in Qwen2.5-VL-7B widens, but its overall flip rate stays high at 91.7% ( C ). Qwen2.5-VL-3B already answers left on 71.0% of left–right questions, against 47.8% in the gold labels. In a post hoc analysis of this model, all original right answers flip but only 62.2% of the left ones, so part of its effect is a fallback to the prior ( Table C.2 ). We therefore rest the main conclusion on Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B, InternVL3-2B and the four-option benchmark of Section 4.3 . A position-only 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} rotation, which mirrors both axes of the ViT and LLM-side position ids, agrees with the real rotation on 76.2–82.2% of left–right questions in the core models ( Table 2 ).

On all up–down items, the width mirror changes 11.2%, 8.6% and 14.6% of the answers (Qwen2.5-VL-3B, Qwen2.5-VL-7B, InternVL3-2B; Table 2 ), more than on the geometry-consistent ones.

blocks.en: Two explanations remain: the mirror may be a less local edit for learned absolute embeddings, or the small model may be unstable. To separate them we ran the same protocol on InternVL3-8B, which pairs the same vision encoder (InternViT-300M) with a larger LLM (last column of Table 2 ). Its main effect matches the other models. The leakage of the width mirror into up–down answers shrinks from 14.6% to 8.6% on all items, the level of Qwen2.5-VL-7B (8.6%). On What’sUp, the height mirror also swaps left and right less often ( B ). On the geometry-consistent CV-Bench left–right items, its height mirror changes 12.0% of the answers, against 10.8% and 8.2% in the Qwen2.5-VL models, a difference we did not test ( Table 2 ). On the geometry-consistent items the reduction of the width-mirror leakage is not significant ( − - 3.9 points [ − - 8.0, +0.1]). The pattern may point to model size rather than to the way the absolute embedding is mirrored, but a single larger model cannot show this ( Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 还剩下两个解释:镜像可能是一个不太适合本地编辑的被学习到的绝对嵌入,或者小模型可能不稳定. 为了分离它们,我们在InternVL3-8B上运行了同一种协议,它将同一种视觉编码器(InternViT-300M)与更大的LLM(表2上一栏)相配. 它的主要效果与其他模型相匹配. 将宽镜渗入自上而下的答复从14.6%缩小到所有物品的8.6%,其水平为Quen2.5-VL-7B (8.6%)。 在What's Up上,高镜也很少左右相换(B. 在几何学一致的CV-Bench左-右项目上,它的高度镜会改变12.0%的答案,而在Quen2.5-VL模型中则会改变10.8%和8.2%,这是我们没有测试的差别(表2)。 在与几何相符合的项目上,宽度-迷宫外漏的减少并不显著(−- 3.9分 [− 8.0,+0.1])。 模式可能指向模型大小,而不是绝对嵌入被镜像的方式,但单个更大的模型无法显示这一点(第5.3节).

blocks.en: 4.2 LLM-side position ids and token order
blocks.zh: 4.2 LLM-侧位置标识和令牌顺序

blocks.en: Mirroring the width component of the LLM-side position ids of the visual tokens ( LLM-W ) changes at most 2.5% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers in the core models. The largest Wilson upper bound is about 5%. LLM-W agrees with the original answers, not with the flipped-image answers ( Table 2 ). The two model families test this differently. In Qwen2.5-VL, M-RoPE assigns the width component to the lowest-frequency rotary channels (at most 1.78 × 10 − 4 1.78\times 10^{-4} radians per position). For an image 36 merged tokens wide, mirroring the width ids thus changes no rotation angle by more than 0.0062 rad. The Qwen width channel carries little within-image position by construction, and a null effect of LLM-W in Qwen is weak evidence on its own. In InternVL3-2B, whose LLM uses one-dimensional RoPE over all frequencies, LLM-W permutes the position ids of the visual tokens within each row and changes their relative positions substantially. Ids move by up to 15 positions, which changes the rotation angles, wrapped to [ 0 , π ] [0,\pi] , by 0.32 rad on average over channels and tokens, against at most 0.0062 rad in Qwen2.5-VL. The edit thus changes rotation angles far more than in Qwen2.5-VL, and it too leaves almost all left–right answers unchanged. With the ViT code intact, no additional effect of the LLM-side ids is thus detected in InternVL3-2B. InternVL3 was trained with variable position increments (V2PE; Section 5.3 ), but its LLM is not insensitive to these ids: once the ViT width code is removed, the id mirror alone flips 20.5% [11.2, 34.5] of the few geometry-consistent left–right answers that remain ( B ). For Qwen2.5-VL, the token-order test below supports the same conclusion.
blocks.zh: 镜像视觉符号(LLM-W)LLM-侧位置ID的宽度部分,在核心模型中以最多2.5%的几何相容的左-右答案来变化. 最大的威尔逊上行约5%. LLM-W同意原始答案,而不是倒转的图像答案(表2.). 两个模范家庭对此进行了不同的考验. 在Quen2.5-VL中,M-ROPE将宽度组件分配到最低频率回旋通道(每个位置最多为1.78×10−4.1.78\times 10^{-4}弧度). 对于一个图像 36 合并了的符号宽度,镜像宽度 ids 从而改变不旋转角度 超过 0.0062 rad. Quen宽道通过构造很少带入图像内部位置,而LLM-W在Quen的无效效果是自身证据薄弱. 在InternVL3-2B中,其LLM在所有频率上使用一维的RoPE,LLM-W会将可视符号在每行内的位置ID进行穿透并大幅改变其相对位置. Ids移动最多可达15个位置,这改变了旋转角度,包裹到[0,π] [0,\pi],在频道和道具上平均0.32 rad,而Quen2.5-VL中最高为0.062 rad. 因此,编辑会比Quen2.5-VL中的旋转角度变化多得多,它也使几乎所有左-右答案保持不变。 由于ViT编码完好无损,因此在InternVL3-2B中检测不到LLM-侧式ids的额外效果. InternVL3接受了可变位置增量(V2PE; 第5.3节)的训练,但是它的LLM对这些ID并非不敏感:一旦去掉VIT宽码,id镜本身就翻转了所剩去的少数几何—相容的左-右答案中的20.5% [11.2,34.5] (B). 对于Quen2.5-VL,下面的令牌顺序测试支持同一结论.

blocks.en: A causal LLM could also read direction from the order in which the visual tokens arrive rather than from their ids. In Qwen2.5-VL, moving the tokens to mirrored seats while each keeps its own id (order only, width) changes 2.3–2.9% of the left–right answers ( Table 3 ). This rate is no higher than the off-axis control that mirrors the row order (3.7–4.4%) or a non-directional change from row-major to column-major order (3.1–3.9%). In InternVL3-2B, the same order-only test changes 2.0% [0.9, 4.7] of the geometry-consistent left–right answers. Within a single image tile, then, and with the ViT position code intact, we detected no use of the ids (with far larger angle changes in InternVL3-2B) or of the order of the visual tokens for the left–right direction.
blocks.zh: 一种因果LLM还可以从视觉符号到达的顺序而不是从它们的ID读取方向. 在 Quen2.5- VL 中,将符号移动到镜像座椅上,而每个座椅保留自己的ID(仅顺序,宽度)则会改变2.3–2.9%的左-右答案(表3). 这一比率并不高于反射出行顺序(3.7–4.4%)或从行主向行主向行主方向变化的离轴控制(3.1–3.9%). 在"InternVL3-2B"中,同一种只按顺序进行的测试会改变几何相容的左-右答案的2.0% [0.9, 4.7]. 因此,在一个单一的图像平板内,而且ViT位置代码完好无损,我们检测到没有使用ID(在InternVL3-2B中角度变化要大得多),也没有使用左-右方向的视觉符号顺序.

blocks.en: In Qwen3-VL-4B [ 44 ] , ViT-W flips 93.9% [90.8, 96.0] of the 344 geometry-consistent left–right answers on CV-Bench and 99.5% [97.3, 99.9] of the 203 on What’sUp. LLM-W flips 2.0% [1.0, 4.1] and 1.5% [0.5, 4.3], and the order-only mirror 0.3% [0.1, 1.6] and 0.0% [0.0, 1.9]. The ViT width code thus suffices to flip most answers, and no use of the LLM-side width ids or of the token order was detected on either benchmark. On CV-Bench, ViT-W agrees with H-flip on 89.6% of all left–right questions, against 6.3% for the original answers. The same-axis permutation controls, run post hoc, give the same picture as in the core models ( B ). On CV-Bench, the half-grid shift flips 77.6% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers and the random permutations 0.30 [0.27, 0.34] as many as the mirror. Among random permutations alone, those that reverse the column order of the two objects flip +28.0 points more of these answers than those that keep it. On What’sUp, a change to the mirror relation comes with the mirror (91.1% of the changed answers) and the shift (83.1%), not with random permutations (3.0–12.0%). In this model, too, the order reading rests on the random permutations on CV-Bench, whereas on What’sUp they rarely move its answers to the mirror relation; the changes also reflect disruption.
blocks.zh: 在Qwen3-VL-4B [44]中,VIT-W在CV-Bench上翻转了344个与几何相适应的左-右答案中的93.9% [90.8,96.0] 和在What's Up上翻转了203的99.5% [97.3,99.9] 。 LLM-W翻转了2.0% [1.0, 4.1] 和1.5% [0.5, 4.3] , 单镜为0.3% [0.1, 1.6] 和0.0 [0.0, 1.9] 。 因此,ViT宽码足以翻转大多数答案,在两个基准上都没有发现使用LLM-侧宽码或符号顺序. 在CV-Bench上,Vit-W同意H-flip占所有左-右问题的89.6%,而原始答案为6.3%。 同轴相通控制,运行后相通,给出与核心模型(B. 在CV-Bench上,半网格转动翻转了77.6%的几何-相容的左-右对接和随机通接的0.30 [0.27,0.34] 和镜子一样多. 单是随机排列,那些颠倒两个对象的列顺序的人翻出+28.0分的这些答案比保留这些答案多出. 在“What's Up”上,对镜像关系的改变与镜像(91.1%的被更改的答案)和相变(83.1%)有关,而不是随机排列(3.0-12.0 % ) 。 在这个模型中,读取的顺序也基于CV-Bench上的随机排列,而What'sUp上他们很少将答案移动到镜像关系;这些变化也反映了干扰。

blocks.en: The main runs give InternVL3-2B a single tile. Its default dynamic tiling splits the image into up to 12 tiles and adds a thumbnail, and the LLM-side result holds there too. Mirroring the LLM-side width ids across the whole image, which also reverses the order of the tile columns, flips 2.8% [1.4, 5.8] of the 246 geometry-consistent left–right answers, and the corresponding order-only mirror flips 2.8% [1.4, 5.8]. Mirroring the absolute embedding within each tile and within the thumbnail flips 86.2% [81.3, 89.9]. In all three model series, and in InternVL3-2B also under its default tiling, no LLM-side use of the width ids or of the token order for left and right was detected with the ViT code intact.
blocks.zh: 主跑为InternVL3-2B提供单瓦. 它的默认活性平板将图像分出至12个瓦并添加了缩略图,LLM-侧结果也在那里保存. 在整个图像上镜出LLM-侧宽ids,也颠倒了瓦片列的顺序,将246个几何相容的左-右相通答的 2.8% [1.4, 5.8]翻出,而相应的只顺序的镜面翻出 2.8% [1.4, 5.8]. 镜像每个瓦片和缩略图内绝对嵌入的翻转率86.2% [81.3, 89.9]. 在所有三个型号系列中,以及在InternVL3-2B也在其默认的平板化下,没有LLM-侧使用宽度代号或左侧和右侧的代号顺序被检测出ViT代码完好无损.

blocks.en: We also removed the ViT width position code, with constant ViT width ids in Qwen2.5-VL and absolute embeddings averaged over the width in InternVL3-2B. Left–right accuracy then falls to 48.0–50.1% in the core models, while up–down accuracy changes by at most 5.6 points ( B ). In Qwen2.5-VL, constant width ids remove the relative width rotation and thus repeat the Mask-VE-w ablation of [ 5 ] , which already collapsed the left–right answers of Qwen2.5-VL-7B on What’sUp; this control adds the LLM-side mirrors on the items that remain. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the fall comes about because, post hoc, 99.2% of its answers collapse to left , so its accuracy alone does not distinguish chance-level answering from such a collapse. On the few geometry-consistent items that remain (47 in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 44 in InternVL3-2B), mirroring the LLM-side order and ids together still flips 29.8% [18.7, 44.0] and 29.5% [18.2, 44.2] of the answers, so a weak LLM-side contribution on these items is not excluded. This shows that the ViT route dominates in these trained models. It does not show that an LLM trained differently could not carry the direction ( Section 5.3 ). Across separately encoded tiles, however, the LLM uses their order: on the CV-Bench validation questions, splitting the image into two side-by-side tiles without a thumbnail lowers the left–right accuracy of InternVL3-2B from 73.1% to 66.7%, and swapping the two tiles lowers it to 63.0% (mean log-odds margin of the gold answer − - 0.643 nats [ − - 0.901, − - 0.395]). The result is consistent with the report that visual-token norms suppress the LLM’s position encoding in LLaVA [ 9 ] , although we did not measure token norms.
blocks.zh: 我们还去掉了ViT宽度位置代码,在Quen2.5-VL中常有ViT宽度的ID,在InternVL3-2B中绝对嵌入在宽度上的平均. 左-右精度在核心模型中会下降到48.0–50.1%,而上-下精度则在最高5.6分(B )下变化. 在 Quen2.5- VL 中,常宽 ids 取消了相对宽度旋转,从而重复了 [5] 的 Mask-VE-w 缩放,它已经崩溃了 Quen2.5-VL-7B 在 What's Up 上的左-右答;这个控制在所剩项目上添加了 LLM-侧镜. 在 Qwen2.5-VL-3B 中, 秋天的到来是因为, 事后临时, 99.2%的答案倒向了左方, 因此, 仅仅它的准确性并不能区分机会级的回答和这样的倒塌。 在所剩的少数几何相符合的物品上(Quen2.5-VL-7B有47个,InternVL3-2B有44个),反射出LLM-侧顺序和ID相加仍然翻出29.8%[18.7,44.0]和29.5%[18.2,44.2]的答案,因此这些物品的LLM-侧贡献很弱,不排除. 这表明VIT路线在这些训练有素的模型中占主导地位. 报告没有表明受过不同培训的LLM不能走这个方向(第5.3节)。 然而,LLM在单独编码的瓦片上使用它们的顺序:在CV-Bench验证问题上,将图像分出为两块相接而无缩略图的瓦片,将InternVL3-2B的左-右精度从73.1%下至66.7%,而将两块瓦的相接将下至63.0%(黄金答案的平均值对数比值−-0.643纳特 [−-0.901,−-0.395]). 虽然我们没有测量象征性的规范, 但这个结果与报告一致。

Pooling the three shuffle seeds overstates the precision of that control; in neither model does the mirrored row order change clearly more up–down answers than both non-mirror permutations, and in 3B only about half of its flips agree with the real vertical flip.

blocks.en: 4.3 Replication on What’sUp
blocks.zh: 4.3 对What ' s Up的复制

blocks.en:
What’sUp [ 1 ] photographs the same objects in controlled arrangements. Its four options allow a stricter test: a directional effect should turn left into right , not into on or under . On the geometry-consistent left–right items, ViT-W changes 99.0–100.0% of the answers and turns 72.1–94.9% into the mirror relation, while LLM-W changes 0.0–1.0% (Wilson upper bounds 2–4%; Table 4 , Figure 2 b). The mirror-relation rate, which we adopted as the main metric here after the run, is stricter than the change rate. The half-grid shift turns a similar share of the answers it changes into the mirror relation (67–97%; B ), so the share shows that the change goes to the opposite side, not that it is specific to the mirror.
The four options also expose a non-directional component of the width mirror. In Qwen2.5-VL, 17.7% (Qwen2.5-VL-3B) and 27.9% (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) of these items move to on or under instead of the opposite side. The width mirror also changes 11.1–19.1% of the up–down answers, more than on CV-Bench. Conversely, the off-axis height mirror changes 37.8–60.4% of the left–right answers, but in the Qwen2.5-VL models almost never to the opposite side. Counting all left–right items of Qwen2.5-VL-7B, 111 of the 118 answers that change under ViT-H go to on or under . These off-option changes also explain why the agreement of ViT-W with H-flip over all left–right items of Qwen2.5-VL-7B is lower on What’sUp (71.4%) than on CV-Bench (93.2%). Whatever the reason for these non-directional changes, the directional part of the width effect is large, and the LLM-side mirror changes few answers (0.0–1.0%).
blocks.zh:
What's Up [1] 在受控安排中拍摄相同的物体。 它的四个选项允许一个更严格的测试:方向效应应该被左转为右转,而不是在上或下. 在几何-相容的左-右项目上,VIT-W更改了99.0-100.0%的答案,并将72.1%-94.9%的答案转换为镜像关系,而LLM-W更改了0.0-1.0%(威尔逊上界为2-4%;表4,图2b). 我们采用镜像关系率作为运行后的主要衡量标准,比变化率更严格。 半网格变换将其所改变的答案的类似比例转换为镜像关系(67–97%;B),因此该比例显示变化会到相反的一面去,而不是具体到镜像.
这四个选项也暴露出宽镜的非方向组件. 在Quen2.5-VL中,17.7%(Quen2.5-VL-3B)和27.9%(Quen2.5-VL-7B)的这些物品移动到上方或下方,而不是反面. 宽镜也会改变11.1-19.1%的上下答案,超过CV-Bench上的. 反之,离轴高镜会改变37.8–60.4%的左-右答案,但是在Quen2.5-VL模型中几乎从未出现相反的一面. 计算所有左-右的Qwen2.5-VL-7B, 在Vit-H下变化的118个答案中的111个继续或继续。 这些非选择性的变化也解释了为什么ViT-W与H-flip在所有左翼-右翼项目(Quen2.5-VL-7B)上的协议在What's Up(71.4%)上低于CV-Bench(93.2%)。 无论这些非向性变化的原因为何,宽度效应的方向部分都很大,而LLM-侧面镜面改变的答案很少(0.0–1.0%).

blocks.en: 4.4 Localization within the ViT
blocks.zh: 4.4 虚拟技术内部本地化

blocks.en: We applied the width mirror in single blocks (7, 15 and 23 to 31), in the four full-attention blocks together, in all blocks except the last, and in all blocks. In Qwen2.5-VL, mirroring the width ids in the last block alone changes 47.0% of the left–right answers in Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 68.1% in Qwen2.5-VL-7B. This is the full effect of mirroring all 32 blocks in the 3B model (101%) and 76% of it in the 7B model. Mirroring every block except the last leaves 28–39% of the full effect, and every other single block we tested changes few answers ( Figure 3 a): blocks 7, 15 and 23 change 2.1–6.3% (Qwen2.5-VL-3B) and 1.8–4.2% (Qwen2.5-VL-7B), and blocks 24–30 1.0–3.4% and 0.0–1.8%; blocks 0–6, 8–14 and 16–22 were not mirrored singly. Post hoc, the direction of these changes differs. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the last block alone changes answers in both directions (111 from right to left and 69 the other way). Mirroring every block except the last instead changes them almost only from right to left (69 against 1), a fallback to the model’s left prior. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the effect therefore sits in the last block, and the earlier blocks mainly disrupt. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the changes from all but the last block go both ways (43 and 52). In Qwen2.5-VL-3B, a dose–response curve agrees: mirroring only the last four blocks changes 47.8% of the answers, as many as mirroring all blocks (46.7%), whereas mirroring the first 28 blocks changes 17.8% ( Figure 3 b). In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the four full-attention blocks together reach the full effect (89.6%, against 89.3%), although the three earlier ones change few answers on their own.
blocks.zh: 我们把宽镜用在了单块(7、15和23至31个)、四个全方位块、除最后一块外的所有块和所有块中。 在Quen2.5-VL中,反射出仅最后一个块的宽度ids就改变47.0%的左-右答案在Quen2.5-VL-3B中为68.1%. 这是3B模型中所有32个块(101%)和7B模型中76%的倒影的全部效果. 反射每个区块, 除了最后的叶子28-39%的全部效果, 我们测试的每一个其他区块都很少改变答案(图3a): 第7、15和23个区块2.1-6.3%(Qun2.5-VL-3B)和1.8-4.2%(Qun2.5-VL-7B), 第24至30个区块1.0-3.4%和0.0-1.8; 第0至6、8至14和16至22个区块没有被单独反映。 后临时,这些变化的方向不同. 在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,仅最后一个块就改变双向的答案(从右到左有111个,从左到右有69个). 镜像每个区块,除了最后一个区块之外,几乎只从右到左(69对1)改变它们,这是模型之前左侧的倒数. 在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,效果因此坐落在最后一个区块中,而更早的区块主要被打乱. 在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,除最后一个区块外,所有区块的变化都是双向的(43和52)。 在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,一个剂量-反应曲线同意:只镜像后四个区块改变47.8%的答案,如镜像所有区块(46.7%),而镜像前28个区块改变 17.8%(图3b)。 在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,四个全心全意的块一起达到全能效果(89.6%,而89.3%),尽管前三个块仅能改变很少的答案.

blocks.en: Block sets separate the position of a block in the stack from its attention pattern. On the 327 geometry-consistent left–right items of Qwen2.5-VL-7B, mirroring the width ids in the four global-attention blocks flips 95.4% of the answers, as many as mirroring all blocks (95.4%; ratio 1.00 [0.97, 1.03]). The 28 windowed blocks together flip only 6.7%, and the windowed blocks 24–30 0.9%. Mirroring the last eight blocks adds 8.6 points [4.9, 12.2] to block 31 alone (81.0% against 72.5%), and the three earlier global-attention blocks together flip 18.7%. The effect in Qwen2.5-VL-7B thus sits in the global-attention blocks, chiefly the last, not in the last blocks as such. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the two readings cannot be separated: block 31 alone already gives the full effect (86.6% against 83.3% on 186 items), and the windowed blocks together flip 18.3%.
blocks.zh: 块设置将一个块在堆栈中的位置与其注意模式相分离. 在327个与几何相符合的左-右项的Quen2.5-VL-7B上,反射出四个全局关注区块中宽度的ID翻转了95.4%的答案,与所有区块的反射一样多(95.4%;比 1.00 [0.97,1.03]). 28个窗口块加起来只翻出6.7%,而窗口块则翻出24-30.0.9%。 镜像后八块增加了8.6分 [4.9, 12.2] 仅31块(81.0%对72.5%),而更早的三块全球注意的块加起来翻了18.7%. Quen2.5-VL-7B中的效果因此坐落在全局注意区块中,主要是最后一块,而不是最后一块。 在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,两种读取不能分开:单是第31个块就已经产生全部效果(在186个物品上86.6%对83.3%),而窗外的块一起翻转了18.3%。

blocks.en: The two models differ in how concentrated the effect is. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the last block alone carries the full effect, while block 23, another global-attention block, changes only 2.1% of the answers; in this model the effect thus sits in the last block rather than in global attention as such. In both models the last block, itself a global-attention block, contributes most, and in Qwen2.5-VL-3B it is sufficient alone. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the rest of the effect comes from the other three global-attention blocks, not from the windowed blocks next to the last one. Because RoPE acts in every block, the result says which blocks’ rotations matter for the output, not where the direction is first represented.
blocks.zh: 两种模型在效果的集中程度上有所不同. 在 Quen2.5-VL-3B 中,仅最后一个区块就具有全部效果,而另一个全局关注区块 第23 个区块则只改变2.1%的答案;在这个模型中,效果就坐落在最后一个区块而不是全局关注中。 在两种模型中,最后一个块本身就是一个全局性块,贡献最大,而在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,单靠它就足够了。 在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,其余效果出自其他三个全局注意区块,而不是出自上一个旁边的被窗外注意区块. 因为ROPE在每个区块中都有作用,结果说明哪个区块的旋转对输出很重要,而不是首先代表方向的位置.

blocks.en: 4.5 Up–down judgments
blocks.zh: 4.5 上下判决

blocks.en: Earlier behavioral work found that, on camera-perspective benchmarks, VLMs ground horizontal relations in the image but answer vertical relations largely from priors, whereas their on / under answers in simple tabletop scenes are grounded in the image [ 3 ] . Our counterfactuals give a partial, position-level characterization of this asymmetry. On CV-Bench, the ViT height mirror changes only 51.4–69.8% of the geometry-consistent up–down answers in the core models. For Qwen2.5-VL-3B this is the mean of both option orders ( C ), whereas Figure 2 a shows its rate in the original order, 45.5%. The LLM-side height mirror still changes 4.2–12.1% in these models, so on this axis the LLM side is not silent. On What’sUp, with controlled scenes, the ViT height mirror changes 77.9–83.8% ( Table 4 ). How much the vertical judgment depends on the height position thus varies between data sets. With two options, a CV-Bench change rate near one half is also what answering at random would give once the vertical information is disrupted. Non-mirror row permutations of the height code (a half-grid shift and random permutations; B ) separate the two readings in part. Post hoc, the height mirror flips 20.2 [12.7, 27.7] and 26.7 [16.0, 36.1] points more up–down answers than the larger of these permutations in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B, but only 10.2 [ − - 1.1, 21.2] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B; on What’sUp the margin is 33.3–57.5 points. The dose–response curve shows a second difference: in Qwen2.5-VL-3B the effect of the height mirror accumulates over the blocks instead of arising at the end (9.0% for the last four blocks, 27.7% for all; Figure 3 b).
blocks.zh: 早期的行为工作发现,在相机-透视基准上,VLMs在图像中打出横向关系,但主要从前作中解答纵向关系,而它们在简单的平面场景中解答/下解答则以图像 [3]为底. 我们的反事实给出了这种不对称性的部分,位置级别特征. 在CV-Bench上,VIT高镜只改变核心模型中51.4-69.8%的几何-相容上下答案. 对于Quen2.5-VL-3B来说,这是两种选择令的平均值(C),而图2则显示其按原顺序排列的比率为45.5%。 LLM-侧高镜在这些模型中仍然会改变4.2–12.1%,因此在这个轴上LLM一面并不沉默. 在What's Up上,带有可控场景,VIT高镜会改变77.9-83.8%(表4). 因此,垂直判断在多大程度上取决于各数据集的高度位置。 有了两个选项,一个CV-Bench变化率接近一分之一也是当垂直信息被中断时随机给出的答案. 高度码(半网格相移和随机相移;B.)的非模拟行排列将两个读取部分分开. 后相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 剂量-应答曲线显示第二个差异:在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,高镜的作用会积聚在区块上,而不是在区块末端产生(后四个区块9.0%,所有区块27.7%;图3b)。

blocks.en: A content-only control locates a second source of the up–down answers. As for the horizontal axis ( Section 4.1 ), we flip the pixels, now vertically, and flip the ViT and LLM height ids back, so that the content and the order of the token rows in the LLM are mirrored. On What’sUp, in the core models, the answer then moves away from the flipped-image answer on 36.4–64.6% of the up–down questions, against 91.7–97.6% of the left–right questions under the horizontal version. The difference is 29.6–55.3 points, and no interval reaches 0 in any of the three core models. This flip-back rate also counts changes to an off-axis option, which are not directional ( Section 3.4 ); a stricter count follows at the end of this paragraph. Mirroring the row order alone changes 16.9–18.7% of the up–down answers in the Qwen2.5-VL models ( Table 3 ), so the asymmetry can be attributed to the orientation of the content only in part. Part of this difference comes from questions whose answer a real flip leaves unchanged: post hoc, the real vertical flip leaves 28–50% of the up–down answers unchanged, against 0–4% of the left–right answers under the horizontal flip. Neither vertical flip adds the instruction to answer in image coordinates that the 180 ∘ 180^{\circ} conditions add ( Section 3.4 ), so some of these unchanged answers may come from a gravity-based frame or from the support that on and under describe. On the questions whose answer the real flip changes, the difference is 12–33 points (Qwen2.5-VL-7B: 32.8 [23.0, 43.0]; Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 23.5 [15.4, 31.9]; InternVL3-2B: 12.3 [5.5, 19.4]). Post hoc, CV-Bench shows the same over all items for Qwen2.5-VL-7B (58.8% against 84.1%) and InternVL3-2B (38.2% against 76.0%), but not for Qwen2.5-VL-3B (38.2% against 42.8%). All items include questions whose answer a real flip leaves unchanged; on the geometry-consistent items, the content-only flip leaves 80.9% of the up–down and 90.8% of the left–right answers at the original answer in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and 80.2% and 91.0% in InternVL3-2B, but 80.7% and 77.4% in Qwen2.5-VL-3B. Local cues in the content may contribute: the on and under options imply support, which is visible in the content, whereas a horizontal mirror leaves such cues intact, although it can still be detected from text or hands [ 47 ] . The up–down statistics of natural images are also asymmetric, so vertically flipped content is itself an unusual input. The up–down questions of What’sUp ask about support ( on / under ), whereas its left–right questions relate two separate objects. Relation type and axis are confounded, and the contrast cannot be attributed to the vertical axis as such. Up–down answers thus depend on the height position code together with the orientation of the content; a contribution of the order of the token rows cannot be excluded. The stricter count, post hoc, uses the geometry-consistent What’sUp items, which the model answers correctly in both orientations, and asks whether the content-only flip returns the answer to the original one. It does so for 60.6% of the up–down and 66.2% of the left–right answers in Qwen2.5-VL-7B (difference − - 5.6 points [ − - 18.0, 6.4]) and for 71.4% and 81.2% in Qwen2.5-VL-3B ( − - 9.8 points [ − - 20.4, 0.4]). In InternVL3-2B the shares are 66.2% and 91.3% ( − - 25.2 points [ − - 37.4, − - 13.4]). By this count the contrast is clear only in InternVL3-2B. On the same items, the content-only flip moves 18–37% of the up–down answers to the flipped-image answer, against 0–5% of the left–right answers; the other changed left–right answers go to an off-axis option (in Qwen2.5-VL-7B all of them, 33.8% of the items).
blocks.zh: 一个只包含内容的控件会定位上下答案的第二个源. 至于水平轴(第4.1节),我们翻转像素,现在垂直地翻回了ViT和LLM高度ID,这样LLM中符号行的内容和顺序就会被反射出. 在What's Up上,在核心模型中,答案从36.4–64.6%的自上而下的问题上移出,而在横向版本下,91.7–97.6%的左-右问题上移出。 相差为29.6–55.3分,在三个核心模型中任何一个都没有间隔达到0分. 这种倒转率还算作离轴选项的改变,这种变化不是方向性的(第3.4节);本段末尾后面的计数更为严格。 仅镜出行序即可改变Quen2.5-VL模型中自上而下答案的16.9–18.7%(表3),因此不对称只能归因于部分内容取向. 部分差异来自真实倒转的回答没有改变的问题:在临时状态下,真实倒转的回答有28-50%没有改变,而在水平倒转下,倒转的回答有0-4 % 。 垂直翻转都没有添加指令,以在图像坐标中回答180 QQ 180 Circ]条件所加(第3.4节),因此,这些未修改的答案中有些可能来自重力框架或来自描述上和下的支持. 在回答真实翻转变化的问题上,差分为12–33分(Quen2.5-VL-7B:32.8 [23.0, 43.0;Quen2.5-VL-3B:23.5 [15.4, 31.9; InternVL3-2B: 12.3 [5.5, 19.4]). CV-Bench专辑对Quen2.5-VL-7B(58.8%对84.1%)和InternVL3-2B(38.2%对76.0%)的所有项目都显示相同,但对Quen2.5-VL-3B(38.2%对42.8%)则不显示相同。 所有项目都包含一个真实倒转的答案没有变化的问题;在几何-相符合的项目上,仅内容倒转在Wen2.5-VL-7B的原答案上留下了80.9%的上下倒转和90.8%的左上倒转的正确答案,在Wen2.5-VL-3B的原答案上则留下了80.2%和91.0%,但在Wen2.5-VL-3B的原答案上则留下了80.7%和77.4%. 内容中的局部提示可能有所贡献:在选项上和选项下意味着支持,在内容中可见,而横向镜像则留下了完整的提示,尽管仍然可以从文本或手上检测到[47]. 自然图像的上下统计也不对称,因此垂直翻转的内容本身就是一种不寻常的输入. 由上而下的问题“What's Up”问起支持(在/下),而它的左-右问题涉及两个不同的对象。 关系类型和轴被混淆,对比不能归结为垂直轴本身. 因此,上下行的答案取决于高度位置代码以及内容的方向;不能排除符号行顺序的贡献。 更严格的计数,即后临时计数,使用几何相容的What'sUp项目,模型在两个方向中正确回答,并询问仅内容的翻转是否将答案还原到原来的一个. 在Quen2.5-VL-7B(差分--5.6分[−-18.0, 6.4])和在Quen2.5-VL-3B(−--9.8分[−-20.4,0.4])中,60.6%的上下和66.2%的左上右下回答都这样。 在InternVL3-2B中,股份为66.2%和91.3%(−-25.2分[−-37.4,−--13.4]),这一比值仅在InternVL3-2B中明确了。 在同一项目上,仅内容的翻转将上下18-37%的答案移动到倒转的图像答案上,而左上右下为0-5%的答案;而另一个被修改的左上右下为离轴选项(在Quen2.5-VL-7B中,所有,33.8%的项目)。

blocks.en: Table 4: What’sUp (Controlled Images A; 412 questions with four options: left , right , on , under ). The main metric is the fraction that changes to the mirror relation (left ↔ \leftrightarrow right or on ↔ \leftrightarrow under); a change to an off-axis option is not a directional effect. blocks.en: To decompose the answers, we combine the position mirror with a blank gray image, the control used by [ 3 ] . An answer follows position if it flips under the matching ViT mirror (with two options, this includes flips caused by disruption), follows content if it does not flip but differs from the blank-image answer, and follows neither otherwise. Following position is the largest class for left–right answers in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B (77.0–89.3% of the questions). It is not in Qwen2.5-VL-3B, whose left–right answers follow position in 46.7% and neither in 53.0%, in line with its left prior. The third class is larger for up–down than for left–right answers in all three core models: up–down answers follow position in only 38.2–42.7% in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3-2B ( Figure 4 a).

blocks.en: 4.6 The ‘higher means farther’ depth cue
blocks.zh: 4.6 (中文(简体) ). " 更高意味着更远 " 的深度提示

blocks.en: VLMs tend to judge an object that is higher in the image to be farther away [ 4 ] , and we asked whether they read this cue from the ViT height positions. The CV-Bench 3D depth questions were split by item index into a validation half and a held-out test half before the experiment. A question counts as heuristic-consistent if the object higher in the image is the farther one ( B ). On the test half, mirroring only the ViT height ids changes 43.9% [38.6, 49.5] of the answers of Qwen2.5-VL-7B. This is more than mirroring the width ids (19.7%) or the LLM-side height ids (6.1%; Table 5 ). In a post hoc paired bootstrap, the difference between the height and the width mirror is +24.2 points [+17.8, +30.3]. The result replicates the validation half, which is not fully independent because 45 test questions share source images with it ( B ). Its directional part, the share of changed answers that now name the higher object as closer, does not discriminate: the width mirror also reaches 80.0%, against 95.2% for the height mirror. The evidence therefore rests on the comparison of the two change rates, which can also differ because the two mirrors disrupt the image to different degrees.
blocks.zh: VLMs倾向于判断一个在图像中较高的物体更远[4],我们问他们是否从ViT高度位置读取了这个提示. CV-Bench 3D深度问题在实验前按项目指数分为验证半和搁置测试半. 如果图像中较高的物体是更远的物体(B ),那么一个问题就算作是热相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 在测试半上,只反射出ViT高度的ID会改变Qwen2.5-VL-7B的回答的43.9% [38.6,49.5]. 这不仅仅是反射宽度(19.7%)或LLM-侧高值(6.1%)。 在后相配的靴子圈中,高度与宽镜相差为+24.2分[+17.8,+30.3]. 结果复制了验证的一半,由于45个测试问题与它共享源图像(B. 它的方向部分,即现在将更高对象命名为更接近的已改变的答案的分量,是没有区别的:宽镜也达到80.0%,而高镜为95.2%. 因此,证据依赖于两个变化率的比较,这两个变化率也可能有所不同,因为两个镜像在不同程度上扰乱了图像.

blocks.en: Further controls show that the direction of the change is not specific to the mirror either. Row permutations of the ViT height code change fewer answers than the mirror in Qwen2.5-VL-7B (half-grid cyclic shift 22.6%; random row permutations 22.1%, mean of three seeds). Pooled over these four permutations, 94.0% of the answers they change now name the higher object as closer, against 95.2% for the mirror. The share lies close to the 87.1% of original answers that follow the heuristic, as expected if the changes fall mainly on these answers. The share is not fixed by that baseline, since the width permutations reach only 50.0%. The pooled permutations also agree with a real vertical flip at least as often as the mirror (71.7% against 64.5%). Neither comparison separates the mirror from the permutations. What the results support is that the use of the cue depends on the intact height code.
blocks.zh: 进一步的控制表明,改变的方向也不针对镜子。 ViT高码的行通式会比出自Qwen2.5-VL-7B的镜面(半格回转22.6%;随机行通式会变22.1%,取出3个种子的平均值)的会更小. 拼接在这四个平面上,94.0%的答案现在将更高的对象命名为更接近的对象,而镜像的命名率为95.2%. 该份额接近87.1%的原始答案,这些答案遵循了高压,如果这些变化主要落在这些答案上,就如预期的那样。 该份额不是由这一基线确定的,因为宽度的布局只有50.0%。 集合式布局也同意真正的纵向翻转,至少与镜像一样频繁地翻转(71.7%对64.5%). 两者都不将镜面与相通相分离. 结果支持的是,提示的使用取决于完整高码.

blocks.en: In Qwen2.5-VL-3B the effect is weaker on both halves (validation half: height mirror 32.5% [27.4, 38.1], width mirror 27.6% [22.8, 33.1]). Its height mirror changes 37.3% of the answers and the width mirror 27.1%, and the lower Wilson bound of the first falls just below the upper bound of the second ( Table 5 ). The post hoc paired difference, +10.2 points [+3.2, +17.2], points the same way as in Qwen2.5-VL-7B. We therefore read the 3B result as a weaker effect in the same direction, not as the absence of the cue’s use. On depth questions the width mirror is also a less selective control than on CV-Bench 2D. Since pixels are unchanged, a correct depth answer should not change under a position mirror. The result identifies the route of the cue, not a source of depth information.
blocks.zh: 在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,对两个半部分的影响都较弱(验证半:高镜32.5% [27.4, 38.1],宽镜27.6% [22.8, 33.1])。 它的高度镜会改变37.3%的答案和宽度镜的27.1%,而第一个的下行威尔逊束缚紧接在第二个的上行束缚下(表5). 后相对分差为+10.2分 [+3.2,+17.2],指向方式与Quen2.5-VL-7B相同. 因此,我们把3B结果读作同一方向的更弱效应,而不是没有提示的使用。 在深度问题上,宽镜也是比CV-Bench 2D上更具选择性的控制. 由于像素不变,正确的深度答案不应在位置镜下改变. 结果确定了提示的路线,而不是深度信息的来源.

blocks.en: A post hoc analysis on CV-Bench 3D shows which answers depend on the height code, in both models. If the model reads height position as a depth cue, the height mirror should change mainly the answers that originally follow the heuristic. It should rarely change those that go against it, because for them the mirrored heuristic points to the original answer. This is what we observe. In the Qwen2.5-VL-7B test half the height mirror changes 51.0% of the heuristic-following answers and 17.2% of the answers that go against the heuristic, whereas the width mirror shows the reverse (16.3% versus 27.6%). The gap for the height mirror is 25–36 percentage points across both models and both halves ( Table 5 , Figure 4 b). The difference in differences, the height-mirror gap minus the width-mirror gap, is +45.0 points [+23.8, +65.9] in the Qwen2.5-VL-7B test half and +67.1 [+47.2, +86.6] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B (paired bootstrap; 45–67 points across both models and halves). It adds up two gaps of opposite sign: the height mirror changes the heuristic-following answers more often than the others, whereas the width mirror changes the answers against the heuristic more often, which moves them back to the heuristic. The groups of answers against the heuristic are small (29 and 37 items in the test halves). Removing the cue by permuting the rows of the height code predicts the same pattern, and post hoc the row permutations show it, more weakly. Pooled over the four permutations, they change 24.1% of the heuristic-following and 10.3% of the other answers in Qwen2.5-VL-7B (Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 23.1% and 3.4%), whereas the width permutations change 6.5% and 44.0%. This analysis, too, shows that the use of the cue depends on the height code, not that the mirror specifically reverses it. At a similar overall change rate, a height permutation (18.2% of answers changed) remains far more selective for heuristic-following answers than a width permutation (13.8%): the difference in gaps is +52.6 points [28.4, 75.5] in Qwen2.5-VL-7B and +42.6 [24.7, 60.5] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B (post hoc), so a difference in the strength of disruption does not explain the selectivity. On the conflict items, however, the height mirror corrects 11 of the 20 original errors of Qwen2.5-VL-7B and the width mirror 6 (difference +25.0 points [0.0, 50.0]; Qwen2.5-VL-3B: 12 and 15 of 29; post hoc), so the two mirrors cannot be told apart there. On EmbSpatial the height mirror corrects hardly more conflict errors than the width mirror, and the same split does not replicate ( D ). Height in the visual field is a valid monocular depth cue, and the models do not follow it more often than the gold labels do: on the consistent and conflict items of all CV-Bench 3D depth questions, Qwen2.5-VL-7B follows it on 84.9% and Qwen2.5-VL-3B on 81.6%, against 84.9% in the gold labels (differences +0.0 [ − - 2.8, 2.8] and − - 3.3 [ − - 7.3, 0.5] points; post hoc). The data therefore show use of the cue, not over-use: the models follow it about as often as it holds and tell conflict items apart only in part, which lowers accuracy on them.
blocks.zh: CV-Bench 3D的后临时分析显示,在两种模型中,哪些答案取决于高度码. 如果模型将高地位置读作深度提示,高地镜应主要改变最初遵循高地主义的答案. 它很少应该改变那些反对它的人,因为对他们来说,镜像般的休克主义指向了最初的答案. 这就是我们所观察到的。 在Qwen2.5-VL-7B测试中,高镜的一半会改变51.0%的heuristic跟随答案,17.2%的答案与heuristic相反,而宽镜显示的是相反(16.3%对27.6%). 高度镜的相差为25-36个百分点,两个模型的相差均占一半(表5,图4b)。 相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相 它补充了相向标志的两个缺口:高度镜比其他的更频繁地改变与heuristic相跟的答案,而宽镜则更频繁地改变与heuristic相对的答案,这使得它们回到了heuristic. 对照高血压的解答组是小的(29个和37个项目在试验半分中). 通过穿透高地码行来去除提示会预测出相同的模式,然后在指定位置后,行排列会显示它,更弱. 在四个表层上,它们变化了24.1%的跟随热量,在Quen2.5-VL-7B中变化了10.3%的其他答案(Quen2.5-VL-3B:23.1%和3.4%),而宽度表层变化了6.5%和44.0%。 这一分析也表明,提示的使用取决于高度码,而不是镜像具体反向. 在类似的整体变化速率下,高通量(18.2%的答案被改变)对于跟随高压的答案仍然有更大的选择性,而不是宽通量(13.8%):在Qun2.5-VL-7B和+42.6 [24.7, 60.5]中,相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差相差 然而在冲突项目上,高镜纠正了Quen2.5-VL-7B的20个原出错中的11个和宽镜6(difference+25.0分[0.0,50.0分];而Wen2.5-VL-3B:29分中的12分和15分;后相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接相接 在 EmbSpatial 上,高镜纠正的冲突错误几乎不超过宽镜,而同样的分块不会被复制(D. 视觉领域高度是一个有效的单相向深度提示,模型跟随它的次数并不多于金色标签:在所有CV-Bench 3D深度问题的一致和相向项目上,Quen2.5-VL-7B跟随它84.9%,而金色标签中的Qwen2.5-VL-3B则跟随它84.9%(差分+0.0 [−-- 2.8, 2.8]和--. 3.3 [-- 7.3, 0.5]分; 特设后. 因此,数据显示使用提示,而不是过度使用:模型遵循提示的次数与它所持的一样多,并且只把冲突项目分出一部分,从而降低了其准确性。
