blocks.en: 4.7 Robustness and side effects
blocks.zh: 4.7 强性和副作用

blocks.en: The left–right result does not depend on the input mode or on the tie rule. When Qwen2.5-VL-7B receives each image of the CV-Bench validation split (187 of the 650 questions) as a video of four identical frames, ViT-W flips 96.0% of the 100 geometry-consistent left–right answers of Qwen2.5-VL-7B (image mode on the same items: 97.0%). In the same video mode, LLM-W flips 0.0% of these answers (Wilson upper bound 3.7%). Removing every item that involves a bf16 tie changes the main metrics little and reverses no conclusion ( Table C.1 ).
blocks.zh: 左-右结果不取决于输入模式或平局规则. 当Quen2.5-VL-7B收到CV-Bench验证分拆(650个问题中的187个)的每个图像作为4个相同帧的视频时,VIT-W翻转了100个几何相容的左-右答案的96.0%的Qwen2.5-VL-7B(相同项目上的图像模式:97.0%). 在同一视频模式下,LLM-W翻出这些答案的0.0%(维尔森上行3.7%). 删除每个涉及 bf16 平比的项目,都会改变主要指标,使结论少而无反(表C.1)。

blocks.en: The result also holds in four publicly released spatially fine-tuned versions of Qwen2.5-VL-3B (SpatialLadder, SpaceQwen, SpaceR and VLM-R1; Figure 5 a). On left–right items whose answer changes under the real flip, ViT-W agrees with H-flip on 77.3–87.5% of the items, against 79.6% for the base model, and LLM-W changes at most 1.6% of the answers. The mechanism is thus preserved in all four ( E ). Swapping components between SpatialLadder, the checkpoint with the largest accuracy gain, and its base model attributes its gain on CV-Bench Relation to the LLM ( Figure 5 b). The base vision encoder with the fine-tuned LLM recovers the full gain (share 1.15 [0.98, 1.40]). The fine-tuned vision encoder with the base LLM is less accurate than the base model ( − - 4.1 points [ − - 5.7, − - 2.4]). The gain thus follows the LLM. This result is consistent with fine-tuning changing how the LLM uses the output of an unchanged encoder. With one checkpoint, it does not establish this for spatial fine-tuning in general. The swap assumes that the two components can be separated: the drop with the fine-tuned vision encoder and the base LLM may also reflect a mismatch between components that were adapted to each other.
blocks.zh: 其结果还有四个公开发布的空间微调版本的Quen2.5-VL-3B(SpatialLadder,SpaceQuen,SpaceR和VLM-R1;图5a). 在真实翻转下答案发生变化的左-右项目上,VIT-W同意对77.3-87.5%的项目的H-flip,而基数模型为79.6%,LLM-W的答案最多为1.6%。 因此,这四个机制都得到了保留(英)。 在SpaceLadder(最精确增益最大的检查站)与它的基础模型之间搅拌组件,将其在CV-Bench relation上的得分归为LLM(图5b). 带微调LLM的基视编码器能回收全部收益(份额为1.15 [0.98, 1.40]). 与基质LLM相配合的微调视编码器的精确度低于基质模型(−- 4.1分 [−- 5.7,−- 2.4]). 因此,收益遵循LLM。 这个结果与微调改变LLM如何使用一个不变编码器的输出是一致的. 有了一处检查站,它并没有为一般的空间微调确定这一点。 互换假设可以分离出两个组件:与微调的视觉编码器的放出和基础LLM也可能反映出相互相适应的组件之间的不匹配.

blocks.en: The width mirror is not a clean intervention on fine content. When the model reads a single printed word, the mirror tends to reverse the order of the letters but also impairs glyph recognition. Accuracy under ViT-W drops to zero, yet 32–34% of the readings begin with the first letters of the word spelled backwards, against 3–4% for a control word (post hoc, B ). In referring-expression localization on RefCOCO [ 48 ] , the ViT-W box coincides post hoc with the box that the model outputs for the really flipped image (IoU ≥ 0.5 \geq 0.5 ) on 57.3% [48.7, 65.4] of the 131 usable items of Qwen2.5-VL-7B and on 56.4% [48.2, 64.4] of the 140 items of Qwen2.5-VL-3B, against 3.8% and 5.7% for the original input ( LLM-W : 3.8% and 5.7%). Under the mirror the models thus output the box they give for the flipped image more often than not: they pick the object that the flip moves to the queried side and report it in the flipped frame. The boxes of 32.8% of the items (Qwen2.5-VL-7B) fit none of the classes. The mirrors also impair a non-spatial judgment. On the 788 counting questions of CV-Bench, the accuracy drop (original minus edited) of the two Qwen2.5-VL models is 15.6 and 18.3 points under ViT-W and 22.8 and 25.9 points under ViT-H . The real flip and LLM-W leave accuracy unchanged ( Figure 6 a; C ). Counting is thus clearly impaired. The left–right conclusion therefore does not rest on the change rate. With two options any change lands on the opposite relation; the direction is supported by the four options of What’sUp, where 72.1–94.9% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers turn into the mirror relation ( Section 4.3 ), and by the post hoc order split ( Section 4.1 ). The half-grid shift, however, turns a similar share of the answers it changes into the mirror relation. Across the two option orders, ViT-W agrees with the real flip on 86.4%–87.5% (3B) and 89.3%–93.2% (7B) of the CV-Bench left–right items ( Figure 6 b), while the other axis changes on only 4.4%–9.0% and 5.1%–6.2% of the geometry-consistent up–down items. Our conclusions therefore concern relational answers and, post hoc, localized boxes, not fine content ( Section 5.3 ).
blocks.zh: 宽镜不是对精细内容的干净干预. 当模型读取一个单一的印刷词时,镜像往往会颠倒字母的顺序,但也会损害glyph识别. ViT-W下的精确率下降到了零,然而32–34%的读取率却从单词的首个字母向后拼出开始,而控制词(post hoc, B ) 的读取率为3–4%. 在RefCOCO[48]上的参考表达本地化中,Vit-W盒与盒件重合,即:在Qun2.5-VL-7B的131个可用物品中,真正翻转的图像(IoU ≥ 0.5\geq 0.5)的模型输出率为57.3% [48.7 65.4],在Qun2.5-VL-3B的140个物品中,模型输出率为56.4% [48.2 64.4],原始输入率为3.8%和5.7%(LLM-W:3.8%和5.7%)。 在镜像下,模型会输出它们为被翻转的图像提供的框,它们会选择被翻转的物体移动到被质疑的一侧,并在被翻转的框架中报告。 其中32.8%的物品(Quen2.5-VL-7B)的箱子不适于任何类别. 这些镜子还损害了非空间判断。 在CV-Bench的788个计数问题上,两个Quen2.5-VL模型的精度下降(原作减去已编辑)为:Vit-W下15.6分和18.3分;Vit-H下22.8分和25.9分. 真正的翻转和LLM-W的准确性保持不变(图6a;C.)。 因此,计数明显受到影响。 因此,左-右结论并不取决于变化率。 在两个选项中,任何改变都取决于相反的关系;方向得到What ' sUp的4个选项的支持,其中72.1-94.9%的几何-符合左-右的答案变成镜像关系(第4.3节),以及临时命令分拆(第4.1节)。 然而,半网格的转变,将它改变的答案的类似比例转化为镜像关系. 在两个选项命令中,Vit-W同意CV-Bench左下行项目(图6b)中86.4%-87.5%(3B)和89.3%-93.2%(7B)的真实翻转,而另一轴则只改变了4.4%-9.0%和5.1%-6.2%的几何相容上下行项目。 因此,我们的结论涉及关联性答复,以及临时的、局部化的盒子,而不是精细的内容(第5.3节)。

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Where the errors come from
blocks.zh: 5.1 联合国 错误来自哪里

blocks.en: A post hoc analysis of the errors offers a partial answer to why the models still get left and right wrong when an edit of the ViT’s position code alone already changes most answers in the direction of the flip. When the subject and the reference object of a question are swapped, a correct answer should flip. Across the core models, 64–93% of the left–right and up–down errors do not flip, that is, the model gives the same relation regardless of which object it is asked about. Part of these errors is a pure label prior that a blank image also elicits ( Section 4.5 ); the rest depends on the particular pair of objects and is invisible to a blank-image control. Post hoc, 64.3% [59.5, 68.8] of the CV-Bench errors of the core models equal the model’s answer to a blank image. This share exceeds that among correct answers only for the left–right answers of the Qwen2.5-VL models: 93.2% against 62.5% in Qwen2.5-VL-3B, in line with its left prior, and 65.8% against 49.9% in Qwen2.5-VL-7B. For up–down answers and in InternVL3-2B it does not. This pattern is consistent with a failure to bind the relation to the subject and the reference object, the role computation that activation patching traces in the LLM residual stream [ 32 ] . It also fits the report that a lexical bias toward spatial words among the answer options arises on the language side rather than the visual side [ 49 ] and that video LLMs encode motion direction in the vision encoder but fail to bind it to the answer option [ 50 ] . This pattern may also explain why inference-time methods that aggregate likelihoods over flips and subject–object swaps, or check answers against a swap, help on spatial-relation benchmarks [ 36 , 37 ] : such checks discount answer preferences that do not depend on the roles. The swap test alone cannot distinguish such a binding failure from a failure to locate the objects, or from ignoring the reference object, that is, answering from the subject’s absolute position. Such an answer gives the same label after a swap when both objects lie on the same side of the midline.
blocks.zh: 对错误的事后特别分析提供了一个部分的答案,说明为什么当仅编辑ViT的位置代码就已经在翻转方向上改变大部分答案时,模型仍然会左出右出. 当一个问题的主题和参考对象被交换时,正确的答案应当翻转. 在整个核心模型中,64–93%的左-右-下-下-右-下-下-下-右-下-下-左-下-右-下-右-下-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-右-下-右-右-下-右-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-下-右-右-下-上-右-右-下-右-右-右-下-上-右-右-上-上-右-右-上-右-上-右-上-右-右-上-右-右-上-右-上-上-上-右-右-上-右-右-上-右-右-上-右-右-上-上-右-上-上-右-右-上-右-右-上-右-右-右-右-右-上-右-右-上-右 这些错误的一部分是纯标签,在空白图像也引出之前(第4.5节);其余的则取决于特定的一对对象,并且是空白图像控制所看不见的. 后临时,核心模型CV-Bench错误的64.3% [59.5 68.8] 等同模型对空白图像的答案. 这一份额超过了仅对左方的正确答案 — — Quen2.5-VL模型的正确答案:93.2%对62.5%的Qwen2.5-VL-3B,与它的左前作一致;65.8%对49.9%的Qwen2.5-VL-7B. 对于上下级的答案,在 InternVL3-2B 中, 这种模式与无法绑定与主体和参考对象的关系,激活LLM剩余流中补丁痕迹的角色计算一致 [32]. 这也符合报告的说法,即:在答案选项中,语言方面而不是视觉方面出现对空间词的语法偏差[49],视频LLMS将视觉编码器中的运动方向编码,但未能将其与答案选项相接[50]. 这种模式还可能解释为什么推论-时间方法能够将可能性汇总到翻转和主体-对象互换上,或者将答案对照互换上,帮助确定空间关系基准[36,37]: 这种检查折扣回答不取决于角色的偏好。 互换测试本身无法区分这样的约束性失败与未能定位对象,或忽略参考对象,即从对象的绝对位置回答. 当两个对象位于中线的同一侧时,这样的答案在互换后给出了相同的标签.

blocks.en: 5.2 Relation to other mechanistic accounts
blocks.zh: 5.2 与其他机械账户的关系

blocks.en: Our results complement interventions on the LLM side. Direction patching places the causal effect of spatial directions in the middle and deep LLM layers, including in Qwen2.5-VL-7B [ 33 ] . Spatial relation judgments have also been described as coarse object grounding followed by reasoning, without precise localization, mediated by a few LLM heads [ 34 ] . Together with our localization, this suggests a possible chain: the position code of the global-attention ViT blocks would shape the direction carried by the visual tokens, and the LLM would carry it to the answer in its middle layers. We have not tested this chain as a whole. In Qwen3-VL-4B, causal patching between images and their horizontal flips, on items answered correctly in both orientations, indicates that spatial relations are read out through the text tokens of the query rather than directly from the image tokens [ 31 ] . Our edits act earlier, on the position code with the content fixed, and are compatible with such a route.
blocks.zh: 我们的成果补充了LLM方面的干预措施。 方向补丁将空间方向的因果放入中深的LLM地层,包括Quen2.5-VL-7B [33]. 空间关系判断还被描述为粗细物体搁浅,然后是推理,没有精确的本地化,由几个LLM头[34]进行调解. 与我们本地化一起,这提示了一个可能的链条:全球关注ViT块的位置代码将塑造视觉符号所携带的方向,而LLM将把它带入中层的答案. 我们没有测试整个链条。 在Quen3-VL-4B中,图像与其水平翻转之间的因果补丁,在两个方向正确回答的项目上,表示空间关系通过查询的文本符来读出,而不是直接从图像符来读出[31]. 我们的编辑在更早的时候在固定内容的位置代码上行动,并且与这样的路线兼容.

blocks.en: 5.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.3 限制

blocks.en: The width mirror tends to reverse the order of letters but impairs glyph recognition, and the ViT mirrors impair counting ( Section 4.7 ). Our conclusions therefore concern relational answers and, post hoc, localized boxes, not fine content. On four-option questions part of the width-mirror effect is non-directional ( Section 4.3 ), and in Qwen2.5-VL-3B part of the flips reflects a fallback to its left prior ( Section 4.1 ). On four-option natural images (EmbSpatial) the height mirror changes about half of the originally correct answers on conflict items ( D ). Same-axis permutations that are not mirrors also flip many left–right answers, the half-grid shift most of them, so part of the mirror effect is shared by random permutations that reverse the order of the two objects (post hoc), and part is caused by disruption alone ( B ).
blocks.zh: 宽镜往往会倒转字母的顺序而损害glyph识别,而ViT镜则会损害计数(第4.7节). 因此,我们的结论涉及关联性答案和临时的、局部化的盒子,而不是精细的内容。 在四可选问题上,宽-镜效果的部分是非向性的(第4.3节),在倒转的Quen2.5-VL-3B部分中,倒转回了左前部(第4.1节)。 在四可选自然图像(EmbSpatial)上,高度镜大约会改变冲突项目(D.)上最初正确答案的一半左右. 非镜像的同轴通接也翻转了许多左-右对接的答案,半网格转动大部分,因此镜像效果的一部分被随机通接的通接相通,颠倒了两个对象的顺序(后特设),而部分由中断单独引起(B.

blocks.en: In InternVL3-2B, mirroring the absolute embedding along one axis also changes some answers on the other axis. On all items the leakage appears smaller in InternVL3-8B, but not significantly so on the geometry-consistent items, and we tested only one larger InternVL model ( Section 4.1 ). All models show a residual off-axis effect of the height mirror on left–right answers ( Table 2 ). Our models have at most 8B parameters. The LLM-side result covers three model series: Qwen2.5-VL, where the id test is weak by construction, InternVL3, trained with variable position increments (see below), and Qwen3-VL ( Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: 在InternVL3-2B中,倒影绝对嵌入于一轴上,也改变一轴上的一些答案. 在所有物品上,渗出在InternVL3-8B中显得较小,但在几何相容物品上则并不明显,我们只测试了一种更大的InternVL模型(第4.1节)。 所有模型在左-右答案上都显示高镜的剩余离轴效应(表2). 我们的模型最多有8B参数. LLM-侧结果包括了三个模型系列:Quen2.5-VL,其中id测试因构造而弱;InternVL3,受过可变位置增量训练(见下文);Quen3-VL(第4.2节.

blocks.en: Our measurements concern answers to relational questions with few options. They show which edit of the position code changes the answer and in which direction; whether the internal representation is mirrored, and how open-ended descriptions behave, lies outside them. The post hoc split by object order on CV-Bench does not separate the order of the two objects from the half of the image in which the subject lands ( B ).
blocks.zh: 我们的衡量标准涉及解答关系问题,没有多少选择。 它们显示位置代码的哪个编辑会改变答案和方向;内部代表是否被反射出,以及开放式描述是如何表现的,位于它们之外. CV-Bench上按对象顺序进行后临时分拆,不会将两个对象的顺序从主体着陆的图像的一半(B.

blocks.en: CV-Bench questions have two options in a fixed order, and the main runs use bf16 with first-option tie breaking. Removing tied items does not change the conclusions. A re-run of the main CV-Bench experiment with swapped options leaves them unchanged in both Qwen2.5-VL models. Only the height-mirror flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-3B moves by more than five points, and we report the mean of both orders ( Figure 6 b; C ). A re-run of InternVL3-2B with swapped options leaves its conclusions unchanged as well; only its LLM-side height-mirror flip rate moves by more than five points (4.2% to 12.6%; Table C.3 ). Its main runs use a single tile whose aspect ratio is not preserved ( Section 3.2 ); under the default dynamic tiling the LLM-side tests give the same result ( Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh: CV-Bench问题有固定顺序的两个选项,而主跑则使用bf16并有第一选项的平领断. 删除绑定的项目并不改变结论。 CV-Bench主要实验换取选项的再运行使得它们在两个Quen2.5-VL模型中都保持不变. 只有Qwen2.5-VL-3B的高度-mirror翻转率移动了超过5分,我们报告两种订单的平均值(图6b;C.). 重新运行的InternVL3-2B带有互换选项,其结论也保持不变;只有LLM-侧高镜翻转率移动了5分以上(从4.2%到12.6%;表C.3). 其主跑用单瓦,其相距比没有被保留(第3.2节);在默认的动态平板下,LLM-侧测试给出了相同的结果(第4.2节)。

blocks.en: On What’sUp, a flip of the content and token rows leaves on and under answers at the flipped-image answer more often than left–right answers. Counted only as returns to the original answer on geometry-consistent items (post hoc), the contrast is clear only in InternVL3-2B. It compares support relations, which imply contact, with relations between two separate objects; relation type and axis are confounded, so the contrast cannot be attributed to the vertical axis as such. The row order alone also changes up–down answers, so the contrast is not due to the content alone, and the sensitivity of up–down answers to the LLM-side row order could not be attributed to direction ( Section 4.5 ). The depth result is clear only in Qwen2.5-VL-7B; in Qwen2.5-VL-3B the effect points the same way but is weaker ( Section 4.6 ). On the depth test half, row permutations of the ViT height code change fewer answers than the height mirror but move the changed answers toward ‘higher means closer’ as often (pooled 94.0% against 95.2% in Qwen2.5-VL-7B). Both shares are close to the 87.1% of original answers that follow the heuristic, whereas the width permutations reach 50.0%. The directional part of the depth result is therefore not specific to the mirror.
blocks.zh: 在What's Up上,内容和符号行的翻转在被翻转的图像的答案上和下面留下了比左-右答案更频繁的答案. 仅仅算作对几何-相容项目(后特设)的原始答案的返回,对比度仅在InternVL3-2B中清晰. 它比较了支持关系,即指接触关系,与两个独立的对象之间的关系;关系类型和轴是错的,因此对比不能归属于垂直轴本身. 单行顺序也改变上下答案,因此对比不单是因为内容,而上下答案对LLM-侧行顺序的敏感性不能归结为方向(第4.5节). 深度结果只在Quen2.5-VL-7B中清晰;在Quen2.5-VL-3B中,效果指向相同但较弱(第4.6节). 在深度测试中的一半,ViT高码的排位变化的答案比高镜少,但将所改变的答案移到“更高意味着更近”的频率(集合94.0%,而Quen2.5-VL-7B中为95.2%)。 两股接近87.1%的原始答案跟随高压,而宽度的平面则达到50.0%. 因此,深度结果的方向部分并不特指镜.

blocks.en: With the ViT width code removed, left–right accuracy falls to near chance, in Qwen2.5-VL-3B through a collapse to left ( Section 4.2 ). On the few geometry-consistent items that remain, however, the LLM-side order-and-id mirror flips close to 30% of the answers. Cui et al. [ 7 ] describe a secondary, language-side representation of spatial relations in intermediate LLM layers that can partly act as a backup when the vision-derived ordering is removed. Our results leave room for such a weak LLM-side contribution and, in our models and benchmarks, left–right accuracy stays near chance once the ViT width code is removed. IVC-Prune [ 28 ] describes the RoPE positions in the LLM as implicit visual coordinates that spatial reasoning depends on, and keeps the tokens that anchor them when pruning. Our LLM-side mirrors leave the left–right answer unchanged when the ViT code is intact. The two results concern different measures (benchmark accuracy after token pruning versus the direction of a forced-choice answer), and both can hold if the LLM-side positions help to select or locate tokens without fixing the direction. InternVL3 was trained with variable position increments for visual tokens (V2PE [ 43 ] ), which may have made its LLM insensitive to visual-token ids; yet with the ViT width code removed its id mirror alone still flips some answers, and with the ViT code intact Qwen3-VL gives the same null result ( Section 4.2 ). Three studies report LLM-side order or position effects that our left–right tests did not find. In LLaVA-1.5, shuffling the visual tokens lowers accuracy on a synthetic benchmark without semantic shortcuts [ 9 ] ; models trained with the visual tokens in reversed order, or with LLM-side positions assigned concentrically around the image center, differ in object hallucination [ 51 ] ; and in video LLMs reversing the frame order lowers temporal understanding [ 40 ] . Alam et al. [ 52 , 53 ] hold that flattening the image into a one-dimensional token sequence limits spatial reasoning. Their evidence comes from retraining LLaVA-1.5-7B variants with other encoders, with and without 2D-RoPE, not from edits of a pretrained model, and 2D-RoPE helps on some benchmarks and hurts on others. The difference may lie in the models, in the task, in the edit (a random shuffle of all tokens disrupts more than a structured mirror of one axis), in the axis (the order of frames is a sequence that no single-image position code fixes) or in benchmark shortcuts. Shortcuts alone do not explain it: on the controlled images of What’sUp, LLM-W changes 0.0–1.0% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers, and in Qwen3-VL-4B the order-only mirror 0.0%. Our LLM-side result is therefore limited to left–right relations within a single image in the three model series.
blocks.zh: 随着ViT宽码被去掉,左-右精确度几乎落到几率上,在Quen2.5-VL-3B中通过倒塌倒向左(第4.2节. 然而,在为数不多的几何-相容性项目上,LLM-侧序-和-id镜倒转近30%的答案. Cui等编. [7] 描述中间LLM地层中空间关系的二级,语言边代表,在去除从视觉衍生出的命令时可以部分起到备份的作用. 我们的结果为LLM的微弱贡献留下了空间,在我们的模式和基准中,一旦删除了ViT宽码,左-右精确度就几乎没有机会。 IVC-Prune [28] 将LLM中的RoPE位置描述为空间推理所依赖的隐含视觉坐标,并保留了在被打压时所锚定的道具. 我们的LLM-侧镜像在ViT代码完好后留下了左-右答案不变. 两种结果涉及不同的度量衡(符号推后的基准精确度与强制选择答案的方向相比),如果LLM-侧位置帮助选择或定位符号而不固定方向,两者都可以持有. InternVL3接受了可变位置增量可视化符号(V2PE [43])的培训,可能使其LLM对可视化脚趾ID不敏感;然而,随着VIT宽码移除了它的id镜片本身仍然会翻出一些答案,而VIT代码完好无损的Qune3-VL给出了同样无效的结果(第4.2节). 三次研究都报告 LLM 侧顺序或位置效应,我们左-右测试没有发现这些效果. 在LLaVA-1.5中,将可视化符号在不带语义快捷键的合成基准上打乱精度降低 [9];用可视化符号按倒序被训练的模型,或用LLM-侧位置在图像中心周围同心分配的模型,在对象幻觉[51]中不同;而倒置帧顺序的视频LLMs则会降低时间理解 [40]. Alam等 [52, 53] 持有将图像平整成一维符号序列会限制空间推理. 他们的证据来源于再培训LLaVA-1.5-7B变体与其他编码器,有和没有2D-ROPE,而不是来自对被预训模型的编辑,2D-ROPE在一些基准上有所帮助并伤害到其他. 区别可能在于模型,任务,编辑(随机洗涤出所有指使扰乱的不仅仅是一个轴的结构化的镜像),轴(帧的顺序是一个没有单相位代码固定的序列)或基准快捷键. 快捷键本身并不能解释这一点:在What's Up的控制图像上,LLM-W会改变0.0–1.0 %的几何相容左-右向答案,而在Qune3-VL-4B中,只命令镜为0.0 % 。 因此,我们的LLM边结果仅限于三个模型系列中单一图像中的左-右关系.

blocks.en: Without a thumbnail, the LLM of InternVL3-2B uses the order of two separately encoded tiles; with the thumbnail of its default tiling, mirroring the order of the tiles and of the tokens within them changed few left–right answers ( Section 4.2 ). Our results concern static images and the viewer’s (camera) frame of reference; motion direction in video and questions posed in another reference frame were not tested. Images that were mirrored upstream, such as front-camera selfies or radiographs shown in a different display convention, change the correct answer in the viewer’s frame; applications that act on left–right answers need to know whether the image was mirrored.
blocks.zh: 在没有缩略图的情况下,InternVL3-2B的LLM使用两个单独编码的瓦片的顺序;用其默认平板的缩略图来映射出瓦片的顺序和其中的指针的左-右答案(第4.2节). 我们的结果涉及静态图像和观众的参考框架;视频中的运动方向和另一个参考框架提出的问题没有经过测试。 映射在上游的图像,如前相机自拍或者在不同的显示常规中显示的射线图,会改变取景者框中的正确答案;在左-右答案上作用的应用程序需要知道图像是否被映射.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen3-VL-4B and InternVL3-2B, the position code of the vision encoder alone suffices to change most answers to left–right questions: editing only that code, with the image untouched, reproduces most of the answers these models give for the flipped image on two benchmarks, a rate that also contains changes from disturbing the code. A half-grid shift of the code, a non-mirror permutation, flips most of them as well. Post hoc and per item on CV-Bench, in these models and in Qwen2.5-VL-3B, random permutations that reverse the order of the two objects flip more answers than those that keep it, which still flip 16.6–43.5%. On CV-Bench the answer thus tends to follow the objects’ order, which we did not separate from the half of the image in which the subject lands; the changes also reflect disruption. With the four options of What’sUp, a change to the opposite side comes with coherent remappings such as the mirror and the shift, not with random permutations, in Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL. In Qwen2.5-VL-3B part of the effect is a fallback to the left prior. With that code intact, we detected no use by the language model of the position ids or of the order of the visual tokens for left–right relations within a single image, also under the default tiling of InternVL3; the id test is weak in Qwen2.5-VL. With the ViT width code removed, a weak LLM-side contribution is not excluded. In Qwen2.5-VL-7B the effect sits in the global-attention ViT blocks, chiefly the last. Up–down answers change under the ViT height mirror to a degree that varies with benchmark and model; on What’sUp the height mirror flips 33.3–57.5 points more up–down answers than the larger of the non-mirror row permutations (post hoc). There, a flip of the content and token rows also leaves on and under answers at the flipped-image answer more often than left–right answers, a contrast between support and projective relations. Counted only as returns to the original answer (post hoc), it is clear only in InternVL3-2B, and a contribution of the row order cannot be excluded. On CV-Bench 3D, the use by Qwen2.5-VL-7B of the cue that higher in the image means farther depends on the intact height code; in 3B the effect is weaker, and on conflict items the height and width mirrors cannot be told apart.
blocks.zh: 在Quen2.5-VL-7B,Qune3-VL-4B和InternVL-3-2B中,光是视觉编码器的位置代码就足以改变对左-右问题的大多数答案: 仅编辑该代码,而图像没有改变,这些模型复制了两个基准上为被翻转的图像给出的大多数答案,这个速率也包含了从扰动代码中的变化. 代码的半网格移位,非镜像穿透,也翻出大部分. CV-Bench上的后置和每个项目,在这些模型和Quen2.5-VL-3B中,颠倒两个对象的顺序的随机外置会比保留它的答案翻转多,这些答案仍然翻转了16.6–43.5%. 在CV-Bench上,答案倾向于遵循物体的顺序,我们没有从主体降落的那一半图像中分离出来;变化也反映了干扰。 随着What's Up的4个选项,反面的改变会随着镜像和转动等连贯的再映射而来,而不是随机地转动,在Qun2.5-VL和Qun3-VL中出现. 在Qwen2.5-VL-3B中,部分效果是倒向左前. 有了这个代码后,我们检测到没有被位置代号的语言模型或视觉代号的顺序用于单个图像中的左-右关系,同样在InternVL3的默认平板下;id测试在Quen2.5-VL中弱. 随着ViT宽码被去除,弱LLM-侧贡献并不排除. 在 Quen2.5-VL-7B 中,效果坐落在全局关注的 VIT 块上,主要是最后一个. 在ViT高镜下,上下答案变化到与基准和模型不同的地步;在“What's Up”高镜上,比起非模拟行平面(后临时)更大的上下答案33.3至57.5分。 在那里,内容和符号行的翻转,在被翻转的图像解答时,也比左-右解答时更频繁地留下和在解答后留下,这是支持与投影关系之间的对比. 仅算回原答(后特设),只在InternVL3-2B中明确,不能排除行顺序的贡献. 在CV-Bench 3D上,由Quen2.5-VL-7B使用提示来表示图像中更高的表示更依赖于完好高码;在3B中效果更弱,在冲突项目上高度和宽度镜面无法分辨出.

blocks.en: These results have two implications. For diagnosis, the left–right answer changes with the encoder’s position code in the four models with permutation controls (the three headline models and Qwen2.5-VL-3B). Post hoc, on CV-Bench, its direction tends to follow the objects’ order, which we did not separate from the half of the image in which the subject lands. For up–down answers this varies with benchmark and model. Where the relation itself is computed was not localized, however, and a post hoc analysis suggests that most remaining errors do not depend on which object a question is about. Repairs may therefore target the binding of a relation to its objects, the localization of the objects, the use of the reference object or, for left–right answers in Qwen2.5-VL, the label prior, rather than only the position code. For spatial fine-tuning, the component swap of SpatialLadder suggests that gains can come from how the LLM uses the output of an unchanged encoder, which the probe can check for other fine-tuned models. Applying the probe requires that the position ids or embeddings can be rewritten, that the visual tokens map to a known patch grid (per tile, if the image is tiled), and that the rewritten code reproduces the original outputs when nothing is mirrored. The cross-axis leakage of the small InternVL model appears smaller at 8B on all items, though not significantly on the geometry-consistent ones. Whether other models with learned absolute embeddings behave alike can be tested with the same protocol. A further step is to test interventions on the binding step rather than on the position code.
blocks.zh: 这些结果有两个影响。 对于诊断,左-右答案随编码器在有通量控制(三个头条模型和Qun2.5-VL-3B)的四个模型中的位置代码而变化. 在CV-Bench上,它的方向倾向于遵循物体的顺序,我们没有从主体降落的那一半图像中分离出来。 对于上下级的答案,这与基准和模型不同。 然而,在计算关系本身的地方,没有本地化,事后分析表明,大多数剩余的错误并不取决于问题所针对的对象。 因此,修复可以针对与其对象的关系的绑定,对象的本地化,参考对象的使用,或者,对于Quen2.5-VL中左-右的答案,标签的前面,而不仅仅是位置代码. 对于空间微调,SpaceLadder的组件互换表示,LLM如何使用一个不变编码器的输出可以产生收益,探测器可以检查其他微调模型. 应用探测器要求位置ID或嵌入可以被重写,可视化符号映射到已知的补丁网格(每平板,如果图像被打平了),而重写代码则在没有被镜像时复制出原始输出. 小型InternVL模型的跨轴渗出在所有物品上在8B上显得较小,虽然在几何相容的上并不显著. 其他有所学取的绝对嵌入的模型是否行为相似,可以通过同一协议进行测试. 下一步是对有约束力的步骤而不是立场守则进行检验。

blocks.en: The Depth questions were split by item index into a validation half and a held-out test half before the experiments (314 test questions). ‘Higher’ refers to the vertical center of the object’s bounding box. A question is heuristic-consistent if the object that is higher in the image is the farther one. The two halves share 35 source images of the underlying data set: 45 of the 314 test questions, only 1 of them a conflict item, so the held-out replication is not fully independent. The validation half was scored in bf16 with ties resolved to the first option (the validation rows of Table 5 exclude tied items), the test half in fp32 in the original option order with ties counted separately.
blocks.zh: 深度问题在实验前(314个测试问题)按项目指数分为验证半和搁置测试半. " 高 " 是指物体边框的垂直中心。 如果图像中的更高物体是更远的,那么一个问题就是恒定相。 两半共享了基础数据集的35个源图像:314个测试问题中的45个,其中只有1个是冲突项目,因此被搁置的复制并不完全独立. 验证半分被分到bf16中,并解决了与第一个选项的关联(表5的验证行排除了绑定项目),原始选项顺序中测试半分被分到fp32中,并分别计算了链接.

blocks.en: What’sUp, all 206 up–down and 206 left–right questions of the core models (InternVL3-2B with a single tile). The tokens are not reordered, so their rows enter the LLM in mirrored order. The flip-back rate is the share of questions whose answer under the content-only flip differs from the answer for the flipped image; the difference between the two axes uses an unpaired bootstrap (10,000 resamples, seed 0), since the two sets of questions differ. The CV-Bench version uses the archived predictions of the main runs (post hoc).

blocks.en: The controls permute the merged-token columns (left–right) or rows (up–down) of the ViT position code with pixels unchanged: a half-grid cyclic shift and random permutations with three seeds. They were run on the core models and, post hoc, on Qwen3-VL-4B, whose absolute embedding and 2D-RoPE are permuted together. Each control first re-ran the original condition, which reproduced the original predictions on every item. On CV-Bench the half-grid shift flips 77.6–84.0% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers (mirror: 83.3–95.4%), and on What’sUp 67–97% of the answers it changes turn into the mirror relation (mirror: 72–96%). On CV-Bench, the mirror flips 15.0 [10.4, 19.6], 3.2 [ − - 3.2, 10.2], 4.5 [ − - 0.8, 9.8] and 16.3 [11.9, 20.9] points more left–right answers than the larger of the shift and the mean random permutation (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, InternVL3-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B; paired bootstrap over items, 10,000 resamples, seed 0), and on What’sUp 0.6 [0.0, 1.9], 5.7 [2.6, 9.4], − - 0.5 [ − - 2.6, 1.0] and 3.4 [1.0, 6.4] points (post hoc). On up–down items, the same row permutations of the height code serve as non-mirror controls for the height mirror ( Section 4.5 ). The shift swaps the left and right halves of the position code and therefore reverses the order of two objects on opposite sides of the midline, so it is not a direction-free control. Random permutations of merged-token columns, which reverse the order of any two objects in different columns with probability one half, flip 0.50 [0.46, 0.54] as many left–right answers as the mirror in Qwen2.5-VL-7B on CV-Bench, and 0.30–0.82 in the other models and on What’sUp (post hoc). A ratio near one half is expected if the answer follows the order of the two objects, but also if a disrupted code leads to a random choice between the two options. With the four options of What’sUp, a changed answer that falls at random on one of the three other options lands on the mirror relation one time in three. Of the left–right answers that random permutations change, 3–39% turn into the mirror relation in Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL, mostly fewer than one in three, against 72–91% under the mirror; in InternVL3-2B the shares are 40–84% against 96% (post hoc). In Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL, a change to the opposite side thus comes with the coherent remappings of the columns (mirror and shift), not with random permutations. For the post hoc split by object order, the two objects of each CV-Bench Relation question were located with the MS-COCO annotations of its source image [ 55 ] . Of the 359 questions with a COCO source image, 347 could be mapped: the COCO instance boxes were rescaled to the CV-Bench image, the subject is the instance whose box matches the red box drawn in the image (or the only instance of its category), and every instance of the reference category is used. Each box is assigned to the column of the model’s merged-token grid that contains its center (the resized grid of the processor in Qwen2.5-VL and Qwen3-VL, 16 × 16 16\times 16 in InternVL3-2B). A permutation reverses the order if it reverses the column order of the subject and every reference instance, and keeps it if it keeps all; item–permutation pairs with an object in the subject’s column or with mixed outcomes are excluded (none in the core models, 4 in Qwen3-VL-4B). The split pools the half-grid shift and the three random permutations (four per item) over the mapped geometry-consistent left–right items, 191, 117, 140 and 202 of the 327, 186, 244 and 344 geometry-consistent items of Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, InternVL3-2B and Qwen3-VL-4B. Intervals of the differences resample items (10,000 resamples, seed 0), keeping the four permutations of an item together. Reversing permutations flip 71.6%, 71.6% and 74.1% of the geometry-consistent left–right answers in Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B and InternVL3-2B, order-preserving ones 32.5%, 44.0% and 50.2% (differences +39.0 [33.0, 45.0], +27.6 [18.4, 36.4] and +23.9 [15.8, 31.7] points), the mirror 96.3%, 83.8% and 87.1%, and off-axis permutations 2–9%; in Qwen3-VL-4B reversing permutations flip 60.3%, order-preserving ones 19.3% (difference +41.0 points [35.2, 46.9]), the mirror 93.6% and off-axis permutations 2.8%. Split by permutation type, the random permutations alone give differences (reversing minus keeping) of +31.0 [23.4, 38.8], +18.9 [8.7, 28.8], +26.1 [16.9, 34.9] and +28.0 [20.7, 35.2] points (Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, InternVL3-2B, Qwen3-VL-4B), all above zero. Order-preserving random permutations alone flip 31.2%, 42.1%, 43.5% and 16.6% of these answers. The half-grid shift alone gives +46.2 [29.7, 62.0], +26.6 [5.5, 49.4] and +50.1 [35.2, 64.2] points in Qwen2.5-VL-7B, Qwen2.5-VL-3B and Qwen3-VL-4B, but − - 14.2 [ − - 23.3, − - 4.1] in InternVL3-2B, where it flips 82.6% of the items whose order it reverses and 96.8% of those whose order it keeps. The order reading thus rests on the random permutations; that the shift flips most answers is not explained by the order it reverses. The split does not separate the order of the two objects from the half of the image in which the subject lands. Of the items that flip under all three random permutations, only 7 of 24 (Qwen2.5-VL-7B), 5 of 40 (Qwen2.5-VL-3B), 3 of 27 (InternVL3-2B) and 1 of 5 (Qwen3-VL-4B) have the order reversed by all three.

blocks.en: We showed the models synthetic images of 100 single printed words and asked them to read the word. Under ViT-W reading accuracy drops to zero. Yet a post hoc analysis shows that 32–34% of the readings begin with the first letters of the word spelled backwards, against 3–4% for a control word. The letters thus tend to be read in reverse order (post hoc prefix match), while glyph recognition is also impaired.

blocks.zh: 附录 D 空间空间深度

blocks.en: On the near–far questions of EmbSpatial-Bench [ 11 ] (four options, natural indoor images; here ‘higher’ refers to the bottom edge of the box), the height mirror corrects hardly more of the original errors on conflict items than the width mirror: 20.4% [15.5, 26.2] against 19.4% [14.7, 25.2] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B and 22.3% [17.1, 28.5] against 16.8% [12.3, 22.6] in Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and it changes about half of the originally correct answers on these items (49.6% and 48.4%). In a post hoc directional analysis, the height mirror moves answers that follow the ‘higher means farther’ heuristic to the opposite end more often than the width mirror does, by +8.4 points [+4.4, +12.4] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B and +8.3 points [+4.6, +12.1] in Qwen2.5-VL-7B. The post hoc split of Section 4.6 by whether the original answer follows the heuristic, however, does not replicate on this benchmark. On all items of the near–far questions (post hoc), the height mirror changes 55.6% [51.3, 59.8] of the answers that follow the heuristic and 53.6% [49.4, 57.8] of those that do not in Qwen2.5-VL-7B, and 52.5% [48.0, 57.0] and 47.8% [43.8, 51.9] in Qwen2.5-VL-3B. EmbSpatial therefore gives at most weak and mixed support for Section 4.6 . The two benchmarks also define ‘higher’ differently (the vertical center of the box on CV-Bench, its bottom edge here), which may partly explain why the result does not replicate. The height mirror also changes many correct answers on this benchmark (49.6% and 48.4% of the originally correct answers in the conflict group), so it is not a selective intervention on four-option natural images.
blocks.zh: 关于EmbSpatial-Bench [11](四个选项,天然室内图像;这里 " 更高 " 指箱底边缘)的近-远问题,高镜对冲突物品原始错误的校正几乎不超过宽镜:20.4% [15.5 26.2] 对19.4% [14.7 25.2]对Qun2.5-VL-3B [17.1, 28.5] 对16.8% [12.3, 22.6] 对Qun2.5-VL-7B的校正回答大约一半(49.6%和48.4%)。 在后期方向分析中,高镜会比宽镜更频繁地将跟随"更高指向更远"高端的答案移动到相反端的热度,取由: +8.4分 [+4.4,+12.4] 在Quen2.5-VL-3B和+8.3分 [+4.6,+12.1] 在Quen2.5-VL-7B. 然而,将第4.6款临时划分为原答案是否遵循“热度”这一基准,并不重复。 在近距离问题(后临时)的所有项目上,高镜的变化是:Heuristic的回答占55.6% [51.3,59.8],非Quen2.5-VL-7B的回答占53.6% [49.4,57.8],而Quen2.5-VL-3B的回答占52.5% [48.0,57.0]和47.8% [43.8, 51.9]。 因此,对4.6节的支持最多是微弱的和混合的。 这两个基准对“更高”的定义也有所不同(CV-Bench上的盒子的垂直中心,这里的下边缘),这可能部分解释了结果为何不复制。 高度镜也在这个基准上更改了许多正确的答案(冲突组中最初正确答案的49.6%和48.4%),因此它不是对四可选自然图像的选择性干预.

blocks.en: We ran the CV-Bench protocol on four publicly released checkpoints fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B for spatial reasoning and on the base model (revisions in A ), in fp32 and with both option orders (no ties). Because these checkpoints were trained to generate reasoning, each was first checked by greedy generation on 30 items, and a model was included only if its generated answer agrees with the logit-based answer on at least 80% of them. All four were included. The VLM-R1 checkpoint reached exactly this level (80.0%) and some of its generations are degenerate; without it, the result below holds for the remaining three. Table E.1 lists the results, which Figure 5 a plots. Agreement is computed here on the left–right items whose answer changes under the real flip, so the original answer never matches the flipped-image answer. It is computed in fp32 and in the original option order, and the values are therefore not comparable with the agreement in Table 2 . All four checkpoints are fine-tuned from Qwen2.5-VL-3B, and the result does not extend to other architectures. In all four, ViT-W agrees with H-flip on 77.3–87.5% of these items, against 79.6% for the base model, and LLM-W changes at most 1.6% of the answers. The CV-Bench 3D column is descriptive.
blocks.zh: 我们运行了4个公开开放的检查站的CV-Bench协议,这些检查站从Quen2.5-VL-3B对空间推理进行了微调,还运行了fp32的基模(修改版为A)以及两种选择令(无联系)。 由于这些检查站经过了培养推理的培训,因此每个检查站都首先被贪婪的一代人检查了30个物品,只有当它生成的答案与至少80%的这些物品的登录答案一致时,才会列入一个模型。 这四个都包括在内。 VLM-R1检查站正好达到这一水平(80.0%),其部分几代人正在退化;如果没有这一检查站,以下结果将维持其余三代人。 表E.1列出了结果,其中图5为一地块。 在此计算出左-右条目的协议, 其答案在真实翻转下会有所变化, 因此原始答案与被翻转的图像答案不匹配 。 它以fp32和原始选项顺序计算,因此数值与表2中的协议不相上下。 所有四个检查站均由Qun2.5-VL-3B进行微调,结果没有延伸到其他建筑. 在所有四项中,VIT-W都同意这些物品的77.3-87.5%的H-flip,而基数模型为79.6%,LLM-W的变化最多为回答的1.6%. CV-Bench 三维柱为描述性.

blocks.en: In a second experiment we swapped components between SpatialLadder-3B, the checkpoint with the largest gain, and its base model. The two models differ in all 32 ViT blocks, in the merger and in almost every LLM tensor. Each hybrid was assembled from the two checkpoints, reloaded from disk and checked tensor by tensor against its intended source, and evaluated with the code of the checkpoint screening. The re-run base and SpatialLadder models reproduce the screening predictions on all 9100 rows of each model (100.00% identical). Let G G be the gain of SpatialLadder over the base model, and V V and L L the gains of the hybrids with only the fine-tuned vision side or only the fine-tuned LLM. The hybrid with the fine-tuned LLM recovers 1.15 [0.98, 1.40] of the gain and the hybrid with the fine-tuned vision side − - 0.51 [ − - 0.86, − - 0.26] ( Table E.2 ). Assigning the merger to the LLM side instead gives − - 4.2 and +9.3 points for the two hybrids.
